This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

verses.text: Blessed is the man who did not walk in the counsel of the ungodly, and did not stand in the way of sinners, and did not sit in the seat of pestilent men;
but his will is in the Lord’s law, and on His law he will meditate day and night.
verses.display_text:
but his will is in the Lord’s law,
and on His law he will meditate day and night.

verses.text: He will be like the tree planted beside the outlets of waters, which will give its fruit in its season, and whose leaf will not fall off; and everything he does will be prospered.
verses.display_text:
He will be like the tree planted beside the outlets of waters,
which will give its fruit in its season,
and whose leaf will not fall off;
and everything he does will be prospered.

verses.text: Not so the ungodly, not so, but like chaff which the wind flings away from the face of the earth.
verses.display_text:
Not so the ungodly, not so,
but like chaff which the wind flings away from the face of the earth.

verses.text: Therefore the ungodly will not rise in judgment, nor sinners in the council of the righteous;
verses.display_text:
Therefore the ungodly will not rise in judgment,
nor sinners in the council of the righteous;

verses.text: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the way of the ungodly will perish.
verses.display_text:
for the Lord knows the way of the righteous,
and the way of the ungodly will perish.

verses.text: Why did nations rage, and peoples meditate on empty things?
verses.display_text:
Why did nations rage,
and peoples meditate on empty things?

verses.text: The kings of the earth stood ready, and the rulers gathered together, against the Lord and against His anointed. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
The kings of the earth stood ready,
and the rulers gathered together,
against the Lord and against His anointed.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: “Let us tear apart their bonds and cast their yoke away from us.”
verses.display_text:
“Let us tear apart their bonds
and cast their yoke away from us.”

verses.text: The One dwelling in heaven will laugh at them, and the Lord will sneer at them.
verses.display_text:
The One dwelling in heaven will laugh at them,
and the Lord will sneer at them.

verses.text: Then He will speak to them in His anger and trouble them in His fury:
verses.display_text:
Then He will speak to them in His anger
and trouble them in His fury:

verses.text: “But I was appointed king by Him on Zion, His holy mountain,
verses.display_text:
“But I was appointed king by Him
on Zion, His holy mountain,

verses.text: announcing the Lord’s decree: The Lord said to me, ‘You are My son; today I have begotten you.
Ask of Me, and I will give you nations as your inheritance, and the ends of the earth as your possession.
verses.display_text:
Ask of Me, and I will give you nations as your inheritance,
and the ends of the earth as your possession.

verses.text: You will shepherd them with an iron rod; you will crush them like a potter’s vessel.’”
verses.display_text:
You will shepherd them with an iron rod;
you will crush them like a potter’s vessel.’”

verses.text: And now, kings, understand; be instructed, all who judge the earth.
verses.display_text:
And now, kings, understand;
be instructed, all who judge the earth.

verses.text: Serve the Lord with fear, and exult in Him with trembling.
verses.display_text:
Serve the Lord with fear,
and exult in Him with trembling.

verses.text: Take hold of instruction, lest the Lord become angry and you perish from a righteous way. When His fury burns quickly, blessed are all who have trusted in Him.
verses.display_text:
Take hold of instruction, lest the Lord become angry
and you perish from a righteous way.
When His fury burns quickly,
blessed are all who have trusted in Him.

verses.text: A psalm of David, when he was fleeing from the presence of Absalom his son.
verses.display_text: A psalm of David, when he was fleeing from the presence of Absalom his son.

verses.text: Lord, why have those who afflict me multiplied? Many rise up against me.
verses.display_text:
Lord, why have those who afflict me multiplied?
Many rise up against me.

verses.text: Many say to my soul, “There is no salvation for him in his God.” Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Many say to my soul,
“There is no salvation for him in his God.”
Diapsalma.

verses.text: But Thou, Lord, art my helper, my glory and the One who lifts my head.
verses.display_text:
But Thou, Lord, art my helper,
my glory and the One who lifts my head.

verses.text: With my voice I cried to the Lord, and He heard me from His holy mountain. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
With my voice I cried to the Lord,
and He heard me from His holy mountain.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: I lay down and slept; I was awakened, for the Lord will help me.
verses.display_text:
I lay down and slept;
I was awakened, for the Lord will help me.

verses.text: I will not fear tens of thousands of people who together attack me all around.
verses.display_text:
I will not fear tens of thousands of people
who together attack me all around.

verses.text: Rise, Lord! Save me, my God! For Thou didst strike all who were my enemies without cause; Thou didst crush sinners’ teeth.
Salvation belongs to the Lord, and Thy blessing is upon Thy people.
verses.display_text:
Salvation belongs to the Lord,
and Thy blessing is upon Thy people.

verses.text: For the end, among psalms. A song of David.
verses.display_text: For the end, among psalms. A song of David.

verses.text: When I called, the God of my righteousness heard me. In affliction Thou madest room for me. Have compassion on me, and hear my prayer.
verses.display_text:
When I called, the God of my righteousness heard me.
In affliction Thou madest room for me.
Have compassion on me, and hear my prayer.

verses.text: Sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? Why do you love vanity and seek falsehood? Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart?
Why do you love vanity and seek falsehood?
Diapsalma.

verses.text: Know that the Lord has made His holy one wondrous; the Lord will hear me when I cry to Him.
verses.display_text:
Know that the Lord has made His holy one wondrous;
the Lord will hear me when I cry to Him.

verses.text: Be angry, and do not sin; speak in your hearts, and upon your beds be pierced with remorse. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Be angry, and do not sin;
speak in your hearts,
and upon your beds be pierced with remorse.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: Offer a sacrifice of righteousness, and hope in the Lord.
verses.display_text:
Offer a sacrifice of righteousness,
and hope in the Lord.

verses.text: Many say, “Who will show us good things?” The light of Thy face was marked upon us, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Many say, “Who will show us good things?”
The light of Thy face was marked upon us, Lord.

verses.text: Thou didst put gladness in my heart; from the season of their grain and wine and oil, they were increased.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst put gladness in my heart;
from the season of their grain and wine and oil, they were increased.

verses.text: In peace I will both lie down and sleep, for Thou, Lord, madest me dwell alone in hope.
verses.display_text:
In peace I will both lie down and sleep,
for Thou, Lord, madest me dwell alone in hope.

verses.text: For the end, concerning her who inherits. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end, concerning her who inherits. A psalm of David.

verses.text: Give ear to my words, Lord; understand my cry.
verses.display_text:
Give ear to my words, Lord;
understand my cry.

verses.text: Attend to the voice of my petition, my King and my God, for unto Thee I will pray, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Attend to the voice of my petition,
my King and my God,
for unto Thee I will pray, Lord.

verses.text: In the morning Thou wilt hear my voice; in the morning I will stand before Thee and watch.
verses.display_text:
In the morning Thou wilt hear my voice;
in the morning I will stand before Thee and watch.

verses.text: For Thou art not a God who desires lawlessness, nor will an evildoer sojourn with Thee.
verses.display_text:
For Thou art not a God who desires lawlessness,
nor will an evildoer sojourn with Thee.

verses.text: The lawless will not remain before Thine eyes; Thou didst hate all who work lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
The lawless will not remain before Thine eyes;
Thou didst hate all who work lawlessness.

verses.text: Thou wilt destroy all who speak falsehood; the Lord abhors a man of bloodshed and deceit.
verses.display_text:
Thou wilt destroy all who speak falsehood;
the Lord abhors a man of bloodshed and deceit.

verses.text: But I, through the multitude of Thy mercy, will enter Thy house; I will bow toward Thy holy temple in fear of Thee.
verses.display_text:
But I, through the multitude of Thy mercy, will enter Thy house;
I will bow toward Thy holy temple in fear of Thee.

verses.text: Lord, guide me in Thy righteousness because of my enemies; direct Thy way straight before me.
verses.display_text:
Lord, guide me in Thy righteousness because of my enemies;
direct Thy way straight before me.

verses.text: For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they practiced deceit.
Judge them, God! Let them fall away from their counsels. According to the multitude of their ungodly deeds, drive them out, for they provoked Thee bitterly, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Judge them, God!
Let them fall away from their counsels.
According to the multitude of their ungodly deeds, drive them out,
for they provoked Thee bitterly, Lord.

verses.text: Let all who hope in Thee rejoice; they will exult for ever, and Thou wilt dwell among them. All who love Thy name will boast in Thee.
For Thou wilt bless the righteous one; Lord, Thou didst crown us as with a weapon of favor.
verses.display_text:
For Thou wilt bless the righteous one;
Lord, Thou didst crown us as with a weapon of favor.

verses.text: For the end, among hymns, concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end, among hymns, concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.

verses.text: Lord, do not rebuke me in Thy fury, nor discipline me in Thine anger.
verses.display_text:
Lord, do not rebuke me in Thy fury,
nor discipline me in Thine anger.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak; heal me, Lord, for my bones were troubled,
verses.display_text:
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak;
heal me, Lord, for my bones were troubled,

verses.text: and my soul was greatly troubled. And Thou, Lord—how long?
verses.display_text:
and my soul was greatly troubled.
And Thou, Lord—how long?

verses.text: Return, Lord; rescue my soul. Save me for the sake of Thy mercy.
verses.display_text:
Return, Lord; rescue my soul.
Save me for the sake of Thy mercy.

verses.text: For in death there is no one who remembers Thee; and in Hades, who will give Thee thanks?
verses.display_text:
For in death there is no one who remembers Thee;
and in Hades, who will give Thee thanks?

verses.text: I grew weary with my groaning; every night I will bathe my bed, with my tears I will wet my resting place.
My eye was troubled from anger; I grew old among all my enemies.
verses.display_text:
My eye was troubled from anger;
I grew old among all my enemies.

verses.text: Stand away from me, all who work lawlessness, for the Lord heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.display_text:
Stand away from me, all who work lawlessness,
for the Lord heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.text: The Lord heard my petition; the Lord accepted my prayer.
verses.display_text:
The Lord heard my petition;
the Lord accepted my prayer.

verses.text: May all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; may they turn back and be greatly put to shame quickly.
verses.display_text:
May all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled;
may they turn back and be greatly put to shame quickly.

verses.text: A psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Chousi son of Iemeni.
verses.display_text: A psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Chousi son of Iemeni.

verses.text: Lord my God, in Thee I hoped. Save me from all who pursue me, and rescue me,
verses.display_text:
Lord my God, in Thee I hoped.
Save me from all who pursue me, and rescue me,

verses.text: lest he seize my soul like a lion, with no one to redeem or save.
verses.display_text:
lest he seize my soul like a lion,
with no one to redeem or save.

verses.text: Lord my God, if I did this, if there is injustice in my hands,
verses.display_text:
Lord my God, if I did this,
if there is injustice in my hands,

verses.text: if I repaid those who repay me evils, then may I fall away from my enemies empty,
verses.display_text:
if I repaid those who repay me evils,
then may I fall away from my enemies empty,

verses.text: then may the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, trample my life into the earth, and make my glory dwell in dust. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
then may the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it,
trample my life into the earth,
and make my glory dwell in dust.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: Rise, Lord, in Thine anger; be exalted within the boundaries of my enemies. Awake, Lord my God, in the ordinance which Thou didst command,
and an assembly of peoples will surround Thee; and for its sake return on high.
verses.display_text:
and an assembly of peoples will surround Thee;
and for its sake return on high.

verses.text: The Lord will judge peoples. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and according to my innocence upon me.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will judge peoples.
Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness
and according to my innocence upon me.

verses.text: Let sinners’ wickedness come to an end, and Thou wilt direct the righteous one, God who tests hearts and kidneys.
verses.display_text:
Let sinners’ wickedness come to an end,
and Thou wilt direct the righteous one,
God who tests hearts and kidneys.

verses.text: Righteous is my help from God, who saves those upright in heart.
verses.display_text:
Righteous is my help from God,
who saves those upright in heart.

verses.text: God is a righteous judge, strong and patient, not bringing wrath every day.
verses.display_text:
God is a righteous judge, strong and patient,
not bringing wrath every day.

verses.text: If you do not return, He will polish His sword; He bent His bow and prepared it,
verses.display_text:
If you do not return, He will polish His sword;
He bent His bow and prepared it,

verses.text: and in it He prepared instruments of death; He fashioned His arrows for those being burned.
verses.display_text:
and in it He prepared instruments of death;
He fashioned His arrows for those being burned.

verses.text: Behold, he was in labor with injustice; he conceived trouble and gave birth to lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
Behold, he was in labor with injustice;
he conceived trouble and gave birth to lawlessness.

verses.text: He dug a pit and hollowed it out, and he will fall into the hole he made.
verses.display_text:
He dug a pit and hollowed it out,
and he will fall into the hole he made.

verses.text: His trouble will return upon his head, and his injustice will descend upon his crown.
verses.display_text:
His trouble will return upon his head,
and his injustice will descend upon his crown.

verses.text: I will give thanks to the Lord according to His righteousness, and sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.display_text:
I will give thanks to the Lord according to His righteousness,
and sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.

verses.text: For the end, concerning the winepresses. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end, concerning the winepresses. A psalm of David.

verses.text: Lord our Lord, how wondrous is Thy name in all the earth, for Thy magnificence was raised above the heavens.
verses.display_text:
Lord our Lord, how wondrous is Thy name in all the earth,
for Thy magnificence was raised above the heavens.

verses.text: From the mouth of infants and nursing children Thou didst prepare praise, because of Thine enemies, to bring down the enemy and the avenger.
verses.display_text:
From the mouth of infants and nursing children Thou didst prepare praise,
because of Thine enemies,
to bring down the enemy and the avenger.

verses.text: For I will see the heavens, works of Thy fingers, the moon and stars which Thou didst found:
verses.display_text:
For I will see the heavens, works of Thy fingers,
the moon and stars which Thou didst found:

verses.text: what is a human being, that Thou rememberest him, or a son of man, that Thou visitest him?
verses.display_text:
what is a human being, that Thou rememberest him,
or a son of man, that Thou visitest him?

verses.text: Thou madest him a little lower than angels; Thou didst crown him with glory and honor,
verses.display_text:
Thou madest him a little lower than angels;
Thou didst crown him with glory and honor,

verses.text: and didst appoint him over the works of Thy hands; Thou didst subject everything beneath his feet:
verses.display_text:
and didst appoint him over the works of Thy hands;
Thou didst subject everything beneath his feet:

verses.text: all sheep and cattle, and also the animals of the plain,
verses.display_text:
all sheep and cattle,
and also the animals of the plain,

verses.text: the birds of heaven and the fish of the sea, those that travel along the paths of seas.
verses.display_text:
the birds of heaven and the fish of the sea,
those that travel along the paths of seas.

verses.text: Lord our Lord, how wondrous is Thy name in all the earth!
verses.display_text:
Lord our Lord,
how wondrous is Thy name in all the earth!

verses.text: For the end, concerning the hidden things of the son. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end, concerning the hidden things of the son. A psalm of David.

verses.text: I will give thanks unto Thee, Lord, with my whole heart; I will recount all Thy wonders.
verses.display_text:
I will give thanks unto Thee, Lord, with my whole heart;
I will recount all Thy wonders.

verses.text: I will rejoice and exult in Thee; I will sing praise to Thy name, Most High.
verses.display_text:
I will rejoice and exult in Thee;
I will sing praise to Thy name, Most High.

verses.text: When my enemy turns back, they will grow weak and perish before Thee,
verses.display_text:
When my enemy turns back,
they will grow weak and perish before Thee,

verses.text: for Thou hast upheld my judgment and my cause; Thou sattest on a throne, Thou who judgest righteousness.
verses.display_text:
for Thou hast upheld my judgment and my cause;
Thou sattest on a throne, Thou who judgest righteousness.

verses.text: Thou didst rebuke nations, and the ungodly one perished; Thou didst erase their name for ever and for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst rebuke nations, and the ungodly one perished;
Thou didst erase their name for ever and for the age of the age.

verses.text: The enemy’s swords failed utterly, and Thou didst pull down cities; their memory perished with a noise.
verses.display_text:
The enemy’s swords failed utterly, and Thou didst pull down cities;
their memory perished with a noise.

verses.text: And the Lord remains for ever; He prepared His throne for judgment,
verses.display_text:
And the Lord remains for ever;
He prepared His throne for judgment,

verses.text: and He will judge the inhabited world in righteousness; He will judge peoples with uprightness.
verses.display_text:
and He will judge the inhabited world in righteousness;
He will judge peoples with uprightness.

verses.text: And the Lord became a refuge for the needy, a helper at fitting times in distress.
verses.display_text:
And the Lord became a refuge for the needy,
a helper at fitting times in distress.

verses.text: Let those who know Thy name hope in Thee, for Thou hast not abandoned those who seek Thee, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Let those who know Thy name hope in Thee,
for Thou hast not abandoned those who seek Thee, Lord.

verses.text: Sing praise to the Lord, who dwells in Zion; announce His deeds among the nations,
verses.display_text:
Sing praise to the Lord, who dwells in Zion;
announce His deeds among the nations,

verses.text: for He who calls bloodshed to account remembered them; He did not forget the cry of the needy.
verses.display_text:
for He who calls bloodshed to account remembered them;
He did not forget the cry of the needy.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, Lord; see my humiliation from my enemies, Thou who raisest me from the gates of death,
so that I may proclaim all Thy praises in the gates of daughter Zion; I will exult in Thy salvation.
Nations became fixed in the destruction they brought about; in this trap they concealed, their foot was caught.
verses.display_text:
Nations became fixed in the destruction they brought about;
in this trap they concealed, their foot was caught.

verses.text: The Lord is known as He executes judgments; the sinner was caught in the works of his own hands. A song of Diapsalma.
Let sinners turn back to Hades, all nations that forget God.
verses.display_text:
Let sinners turn back to Hades,
all nations that forget God.

verses.text: For the poor will not be forgotten utterly; the endurance of the needy will not perish for ever.
verses.display_text:
For the poor will not be forgotten utterly;
the endurance of the needy will not perish for ever.

verses.text: Arise, Lord; do not let a human being grow strong; let nations be judged before Thee.
verses.display_text:
Arise, Lord; do not let a human being grow strong;
let nations be judged before Thee.

verses.text: Appoint a lawgiver over them, Lord; let nations know that they are human beings. Diapsalma.
Why, Lord, hast Thou stood far away, overlooking us at fitting times in distress?
verses.display_text:
Why, Lord, hast Thou stood far away,
overlooking us at fitting times in distress?

verses.text: As the ungodly man exalts himself, the poor man is set ablaze; they are caught in the counsels they devise.
verses.display_text:
As the ungodly man exalts himself, the poor man is set ablaze;
they are caught in the counsels they devise.

verses.text: For the sinner is praised for the desires of his soul, and the one who acts unjustly is blessed.
verses.display_text:
For the sinner is praised for the desires of his soul,
and the one who acts unjustly is blessed.

verses.text: The sinner provoked the Lord. According to the abundance of his anger, he will not seek out; God is not before him.
His ways are profaned at every time; Thy judgments are removed from before him; he will lord it over all his enemies.
For he said in his heart, “I will certainly not be shaken, from generation to generation, without adversity.”
verses.display_text:
For he said in his heart, “I will certainly not be shaken,
from generation to generation, without adversity.”

verses.text: His mouth is full of cursing, bitterness, and deceit; under his tongue are toil and trouble.
verses.display_text:
His mouth is full of cursing, bitterness, and deceit;
under his tongue are toil and trouble.

verses.text: He sits in ambush with rich people, to kill an innocent person in hiding places; his eyes look toward the needy.
He lurks in hiding like a lion in its enclosure; he lurks to seize a poor man, to seize a poor man as he drags him away.
In his trap he will humble him; he will bow down and fall as he lords it over the needy.
verses.display_text:
In his trap he will humble him;
he will bow down and fall as he lords it over the needy.

verses.text: For he said in his heart, “God has forgotten; He turned His face away so as never to see.”
verses.display_text:
For he said in his heart, “God has forgotten;
He turned His face away so as never to see.”

verses.text: Arise, Lord God; let Thy hand be raised; do not forget the needy.
verses.display_text:
Arise, Lord God; let Thy hand be raised;
do not forget the needy.

verses.text: For what reason did the ungodly provoke God? For he said in his heart, “He will not call to account.”
verses.display_text:
For what reason did the ungodly provoke God?
For he said in his heart, “He will not call to account.”

verses.text: Thou seest, for Thou perceivest trouble and anger, to hand them over into Thy hands. To Thee, therefore, the poor man has been left; Thou wast helping the orphan.
verses.display_text:
Thou seest, for Thou perceivest trouble and anger,
to hand them over into Thy hands.
To Thee, therefore, the poor man has been left;
Thou wast helping the orphan.

verses.text: Crush the arm of the sinful and evil man; his sin will be sought out, and he will certainly not be found because of it.
verses.display_text:
Crush the arm of the sinful and evil man;
his sin will be sought out, and he will certainly not be found because of it.

verses.text: The Lord will reign for ever and for the age of the age; you will perish, nations, from His land.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will reign for ever and for the age of the age;
you will perish, nations, from His land.

verses.text: The Lord heard the desire of the needy; Thine ear attended to the preparation of their heart,
verses.display_text:
The Lord heard the desire of the needy;
Thine ear attended to the preparation of their heart,

verses.text: to judge for the orphan and the lowly, so that a human being on the earth may no longer boast greatly.
verses.display_text:
to judge for the orphan and the lowly,
so that a human being on the earth may no longer boast greatly.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David. In the Lord I have trusted. How will you say to my soul, “Move away to the mountains like a little bird”?
verses.display_text:
For the end. A psalm of David.
In the Lord I have trusted.
How will you say to my soul,
“Move away to the mountains like a little bird”?

verses.text: For behold, sinners bent a bow; they prepared arrows for a quiver, to shoot down in the moonless dark the upright in heart.
For what Thou didst establish, they pulled down; but what did the righteous person do?
verses.display_text:
For what Thou didst establish, they pulled down;
but what did the righteous person do?

verses.text: The Lord is in His holy temple; the Lord’s throne is in heaven. His eyes look toward the needy; His eyelids examine the sons of men.
The Lord examines the righteous and the ungodly; but the one who loves injustice hates his own soul.
verses.display_text:
The Lord examines the righteous and the ungodly;
but the one who loves injustice hates his own soul.

verses.text: He will rain traps upon sinners; fire, sulfur, and a storm wind are the portion of their cup.
verses.display_text:
He will rain traps upon sinners;
fire, sulfur, and a storm wind are the portion of their cup.

verses.text: For the Lord is righteous and loved righteous deeds; His face beheld uprightness.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord is righteous and loved righteous deeds;
His face beheld uprightness.

verses.text: For the end, concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end, concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.

verses.text: Save me, Lord, for the holy one is gone; for truths have become few among the sons of men.
verses.display_text:
Save me, Lord, for the holy one is gone;
for truths have become few among the sons of men.

verses.text: Each spoke empty things to his neighbor; deceitful lips spoke with a heart and a heart.
verses.display_text:
Each spoke empty things to his neighbor;
deceitful lips spoke with a heart and a heart.

verses.text: May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips and a boastful tongue—
verses.display_text:
May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips
and a boastful tongue—

verses.text: those who said, “We will magnify our tongue; our lips are our own; who is our lord?”
verses.display_text:
those who said, “We will magnify our tongue;
our lips are our own; who is our lord?”

verses.text: “Because of the misery of the poor and because of the groaning of the needy, now I will arise,” says the Lord. “I will set him in salvation; I will speak openly in him.”
verses.display_text:
“Because of the misery of the poor
and because of the groaning of the needy,
now I will arise,” says the Lord.
“I will set him in salvation; I will speak openly in him.”

verses.text: The sayings of the Lord are pure sayings, silver tried by fire, tested in the earth, purified sevenfold.
verses.display_text:
The sayings of the Lord are pure sayings,
silver tried by fire, tested in the earth,
purified sevenfold.

verses.text: Thou, Lord, wilt keep us and preserve us from this generation and for ever.
verses.display_text:
Thou, Lord, wilt keep us
and preserve us from this generation and for ever.

verses.text: The ungodly walk around; according to Thy height, Thou heldest the sons of men in high regard.
verses.display_text:
The ungodly walk around;
according to Thy height, Thou heldest the sons of men in high regard.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David.

verses.text: How long, Lord, wilt Thou forget me utterly? How long wilt Thou turn Thy face away from me?
verses.display_text:
How long, Lord, wilt Thou forget me utterly?
How long wilt Thou turn Thy face away from me?

verses.text: How long shall I place counsels within my soul, pains within my heart by day? How long will my enemy be raised above me?
verses.display_text:
How long shall I place counsels within my soul,
pains within my heart by day?
How long will my enemy be raised above me?

verses.text: Look; hear me, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I fall asleep into death,
verses.display_text:
Look; hear me, Lord my God.
Give light to my eyes, lest I fall asleep into death,

verses.text: lest my enemy say, “I prevailed against him.” Those who afflict me will exult if I am shaken.
verses.display_text:
lest my enemy say, “I prevailed against him.”
Those who afflict me will exult if I am shaken.

verses.text: But I have hoped in Thy mercy; my heart will exult in Thy salvation. I will sing to the Lord, who has benefited me, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.display_text:
But I have hoped in Thy mercy;
my heart will exult in Thy salvation.
I will sing to the Lord, who has benefited me,
and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David. A fool said in his heart, “There is no God.” They acted corruptly and became abominable in their practices; there is no one who shows kindness; there is not even one.
verses.display_text:
For the end. A psalm of David.
A fool said in his heart, “There is no God.”
They acted corruptly and became abominable in their practices;
there is no one who shows kindness; there is not even one.

verses.text: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands or seeks God.
verses.display_text:
The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men,
to see whether there is anyone who understands or seeks God.

verses.text: All turned aside; together they became useless; there is no one who shows kindness, not even one. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they practiced deceit. The venom of asps is under their lips; their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness. Their feet are swift to shed blood; brokenness and misery are in their ways, and they did not know a way of peace. There is no fear of God before their eyes.
Will all those who practice lawlessness not know? Those who devour my people as a meal of bread did not call upon the Lord.
verses.display_text:
Will all those who practice lawlessness not know?
Those who devour my people as a meal of bread did not call upon the Lord.

verses.text: There they cowered in fear where there was no fear, for God is with a righteous generation.
verses.display_text:
There they cowered in fear where there was no fear,
for God is with a righteous generation.

verses.text: You put a poor man’s counsel to shame, because the Lord is his hope.
verses.display_text:
You put a poor man’s counsel to shame,
because the Lord is his hope.

verses.text: Who will give Israel’s salvation from Zion? When the Lord turns back His people’s captivity, let Jacob exult and let Israel rejoice.
verses.display_text:
Who will give Israel’s salvation from Zion?
When the Lord turns back His people’s captivity,
let Jacob exult and let Israel rejoice.

verses.text: A psalm of David. Lord, who will sojourn in Thy dwelling, and who will encamp on Thy holy mountain?
verses.display_text:
A psalm of David.
Lord, who will sojourn in Thy dwelling,
and who will encamp on Thy holy mountain?

verses.text: One who walks blamelessly and works righteousness, speaking truth in his heart,
verses.display_text:
One who walks blamelessly and works righteousness,
speaking truth in his heart,

verses.text: who did not act deceitfully with his tongue, nor do evil to his neighbor, and did not take up reproach against those nearest him.
verses.display_text:
who did not act deceitfully with his tongue,
nor do evil to his neighbor,
and did not take up reproach against those nearest him.

verses.text: One who acts wickedly is held in contempt before him, but he honors those who fear the Lord; one who swears to his neighbor and does not set it aside.
He did not lend his silver at interest and did not take gifts against innocent people. The one who does these things will never be shaken.
verses.display_text:
He did not lend his silver at interest
and did not take gifts against innocent people.
The one who does these things will never be shaken.

verses.text: An inscription of David. Guard me, Lord, for I have hoped in Thee.
verses.display_text:
An inscription of David.
Guard me, Lord, for I have hoped in Thee.

verses.text: I said to the Lord, “Thou art my Lord, for Thou hast no need of my good things.”
verses.display_text:
I said to the Lord, “Thou art my Lord,
for Thou hast no need of my good things.”

verses.text: For the holy ones who are in His land, He made all His purposes wonderful among them.
verses.display_text:
For the holy ones who are in His land,
He made all His purposes wonderful among them.

verses.text: Their weaknesses multiplied; after these things they hurried. I will certainly not gather their gatherings of bloodshed, nor will I remember their names through my lips.
verses.display_text:
Their weaknesses multiplied;
after these things they hurried.
I will certainly not gather their gatherings of bloodshed,
nor will I remember their names through my lips.

verses.text: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; Thou art the One who restores my inheritance to me.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup;
Thou art the One who restores my inheritance to me.

verses.text: Measuring cords fell for me among the best places; indeed, my inheritance is the best for me.
verses.display_text:
Measuring cords fell for me among the best places;
indeed, my inheritance is the best for me.

verses.text: I will bless the Lord, who gave me understanding; indeed, even until night my kidneys disciplined me.
verses.display_text:
I will bless the Lord, who gave me understanding;
indeed, even until night my kidneys disciplined me.

verses.text: I kept seeing the Lord before me continually, because He is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.
verses.display_text:
I kept seeing the Lord before me continually,
because He is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.

verses.text: Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my tongue exulted; indeed, even my flesh will dwell in hope,
verses.display_text:
Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my tongue exulted;
indeed, even my flesh will dwell in hope,

verses.text: for Thou wilt not abandon my soul to Hades, nor let Thy holy one see corruption.
verses.display_text:
for Thou wilt not abandon my soul to Hades,
nor let Thy holy one see corruption.

verses.text: Thou madest known to me ways of life; Thou wilt fill me with gladness in Thy presence; pleasures are at Thy right hand for ever.
A prayer of David. Hear my righteousness, Lord; attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer, not from deceitful lips.
May my judgment come forth from Thy presence; let my eyes see upright things.
verses.display_text:
May my judgment come forth from Thy presence;
let my eyes see upright things.

verses.text: Thou didst test my heart; Thou didst visit by night; Thou didst try me by fire, and no injustice was found in me,
verses.display_text:
Thou didst test my heart; Thou didst visit by night;
Thou didst try me by fire, and no injustice was found in me,

verses.text: so that my mouth might not speak human deeds. Because of the words of Thy lips, I kept hard paths.
verses.display_text:
so that my mouth might not speak human deeds.
Because of the words of Thy lips, I kept hard paths.

verses.text: Set my steps firmly in Thy paths, so that my steps may not be shaken.
verses.display_text:
Set my steps firmly in Thy paths,
so that my steps may not be shaken.

verses.text: I cried out, for Thou heardest me, God; incline Thine ear to me and hear my words.
verses.display_text:
I cried out, for Thou heardest me, God;
incline Thine ear to me and hear my words.

verses.text: Make Thy mercies wonderful, Thou who savest those hoping in Thee from those who oppose Thy right hand.
verses.display_text:
Make Thy mercies wonderful,
Thou who savest those hoping in Thee
from those who oppose Thy right hand.

verses.text: Guard me as the pupil of an eye; in the shelter of Thy wings Thou wilt shelter me,
verses.display_text:
Guard me as the pupil of an eye;
in the shelter of Thy wings Thou wilt shelter me,

verses.text: from the ungodly who made me miserable. My enemies surrounded my soul.
verses.display_text:
from the ungodly who made me miserable.
My enemies surrounded my soul.

verses.text: They shut up their fat; their mouth spoke arrogance.
verses.display_text:
They shut up their fat;
their mouth spoke arrogance.

verses.text: Casting me out, they now surrounded me; they set their eyes to turn aside toward the earth.
verses.display_text:
Casting me out, they now surrounded me;
they set their eyes to turn aside toward the earth.

verses.text: They took me up like a lion ready for the hunt and like a young lion dwelling in hiding places.
verses.display_text:
They took me up like a lion ready for the hunt
and like a young lion dwelling in hiding places.

verses.text: Arise, Lord; get ahead of them and trip them up; rescue my soul from an ungodly man, Thy sword from the enemies of Thy hand.
Lord, separate them from the few, from the earth, during their life. Their belly was filled with Thy hidden things; they were satisfied with sons and left the remains to their infants.
verses.display_text:
Lord, separate them from the few, from the earth,
during their life.
Their belly was filled with Thy hidden things;
they were satisfied with sons
and left the remains to their infants.

verses.text: But I, in righteousness, will appear before Thy face; I will be satisfied when Thy glory appears.
verses.display_text:
But I, in righteousness, will appear before Thy face;
I will be satisfied when Thy glory appears.

verses.text: For the end. Of the Lord’s servant David, who spoke the words of this song to the Lord on the day the Lord rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
verses.display_text: For the end. Of the Lord’s servant David, who spoke the words of this song to the Lord on the day the Lord rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

verses.text: And he said: I will love Thee, Lord, my strength.
verses.display_text:
And he said:
I will love Thee, Lord, my strength.

verses.text: The Lord is my firm foundation, my refuge, and my rescuer; my God is my helper, and I will hope in Him; my protector, the horn of my salvation, my supporter.
Praising, I will call upon the Lord, and I will be saved from my enemies.
verses.display_text:
Praising, I will call upon the Lord,
and I will be saved from my enemies.

verses.text: The birth pangs of death encompassed me, and torrents of lawlessness threw me into turmoil.
verses.display_text:
The birth pangs of death encompassed me,
and torrents of lawlessness threw me into turmoil.

verses.text: The birth pangs of Hades surrounded me; the traps of death overtook me.
verses.display_text:
The birth pangs of Hades surrounded me;
the traps of death overtook me.

verses.text: And when I was afflicted, I called upon the Lord and cried out to my God. He heard my voice from His holy temple, and my cry before Him will enter His ears.
verses.display_text:
And when I was afflicted, I called upon the Lord
and cried out to my God.
He heard my voice from His holy temple,
and my cry before Him will enter His ears.

verses.text: And the earth was shaken and began to tremble; the foundations of the mountains were troubled and shaken because God was angry with them.
Smoke rose in His anger, and fire from His face set things ablaze; coals were kindled from Him.
And He bent heaven and came down, and gloom was beneath His feet.
verses.display_text:
And He bent heaven and came down,
and gloom was beneath His feet.

verses.text: And He mounted cherubim and flew; He flew on the wings of winds.
verses.display_text:
And He mounted cherubim and flew;
He flew on the wings of winds.

verses.text: And He made darkness His hiding place; His tent was around Him, dark water in clouds of the air.
From the far-shining radiance before Him, the clouds passed— hail and coals of fire.
verses.display_text:
From the far-shining radiance before Him, the clouds passed—
hail and coals of fire.

verses.text: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave His voice.
verses.display_text:
And the Lord thundered from heaven,
and the Most High gave His voice.

verses.text: And He sent out arrows and scattered them; He multiplied lightning flashes and threw them into turmoil.
verses.display_text:
And He sent out arrows and scattered them;
He multiplied lightning flashes and threw them into turmoil.

verses.text: And the springs of the waters appeared, and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered at Thy rebuke, Lord, at the blast of the spirit of Thine anger.
verses.display_text:
And the springs of the waters appeared,
and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered
at Thy rebuke, Lord,
at the blast of the spirit of Thine anger.

verses.text: He sent from on high and took me; He took me to Himself out of many waters.
verses.display_text:
He sent from on high and took me;
He took me to Himself out of many waters.

verses.text: He will rescue me from my powerful enemies and from those who hate me, for they grew stronger than I.
verses.display_text:
He will rescue me from my powerful enemies
and from those who hate me, for they grew stronger than I.

verses.text: They overtook me in the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my support,
verses.display_text:
They overtook me in the day of my affliction,
and the Lord became my support,

verses.text: and He brought me out into a spacious place. He will rescue me because He desired me. He will rescue me from my powerful enemies and from those who hate me.
verses.display_text:
and He brought me out into a spacious place.
He will rescue me because He desired me.
He will rescue me from my powerful enemies
and from those who hate me.

verses.text: And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands He will repay me,
verses.display_text:
And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness,
and according to the purity of my hands He will repay me,

verses.text: because I kept the Lord’s ways and did not act impiously by turning from my God,
verses.display_text:
because I kept the Lord’s ways
and did not act impiously by turning from my God,

verses.text: because all His judgments are before me, and I did not put His ordinances away from me.
verses.display_text:
because all His judgments are before me,
and I did not put His ordinances away from me.

verses.text: And I will be blameless with Him and guard myself from my lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
And I will be blameless with Him
and guard myself from my lawlessness.

verses.text: And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to the purity of my hands before His eyes.
verses.display_text:
And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness
and according to the purity of my hands before His eyes.

verses.text: With a holy one Thou wilt show Thyself holy, and with an innocent man Thou wilt be innocent,
verses.display_text:
With a holy one Thou wilt show Thyself holy,
and with an innocent man Thou wilt be innocent,

verses.text: and with a chosen one Thou wilt be chosen, and with a twisted one Thou wilt twist.
verses.display_text:
and with a chosen one Thou wilt be chosen,
and with a twisted one Thou wilt twist.

verses.text: For Thou wilt save a lowly people and humble the eyes of the arrogant.
verses.display_text:
For Thou wilt save a lowly people
and humble the eyes of the arrogant.

verses.text: For Thou wilt light my lamp, Lord; my God, Thou wilt light my darkness.
verses.display_text:
For Thou wilt light my lamp, Lord;
my God, Thou wilt light my darkness.

verses.text: For by Thee I will be rescued from a raiding band, and by my God I will cross over a wall.
verses.display_text:
For by Thee I will be rescued from a raiding band,
and by my God I will cross over a wall.

verses.text: My God’s way is blameless; the Lord’s sayings are tried by fire; He is a protector of all who hope in Him.
For who is God except the Lord? And who is God except our God?
verses.display_text:
For who is God except the Lord?
And who is God except our God?

verses.text: God girds me with power and made my way blameless,
verses.display_text:
God girds me with power
and made my way blameless,

verses.text: He sets my feet firmly like a deer’s and makes me stand upon the heights,
verses.display_text:
He sets my feet firmly like a deer’s
and makes me stand upon the heights,

verses.text: training my hands for war; and Thou madest my arms a bronze bow.
verses.display_text:
training my hands for war;
and Thou madest my arms a bronze bow.

verses.text: And Thou gavest me the protection of my salvation; Thy right hand supported me, and Thy discipline set me upright completely, and Thy discipline itself will teach me.
verses.display_text:
And Thou gavest me the protection of my salvation;
Thy right hand supported me,
and Thy discipline set me upright completely,
and Thy discipline itself will teach me.

verses.text: Thou didst widen my steps beneath me, and my footprints did not grow weak.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst widen my steps beneath me,
and my footprints did not grow weak.

verses.text: I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until they fail.
verses.display_text:
I will pursue my enemies and overtake them,
and I will not turn back until they fail.

verses.text: I will press them down, and they will certainly be unable to stand; they will fall beneath my feet.
verses.display_text:
I will press them down, and they will certainly be unable to stand;
they will fall beneath my feet.

verses.text: And Thou didst gird me with power for war; Thou didst fetter all those who rose against me beneath me,
verses.display_text:
And Thou didst gird me with power for war;
Thou didst fetter all those who rose against me beneath me,

verses.text: and Thou madest my enemies turn their backs to me, and Thou didst destroy those who hated me.
verses.display_text:
and Thou madest my enemies turn their backs to me,
and Thou didst destroy those who hated me.

verses.text: They cried out, and there was no one to save; they cried to the Lord, and He did not hear them.
verses.display_text:
They cried out, and there was no one to save;
they cried to the Lord, and He did not hear them.

verses.text: And I will grind them fine like dust before the wind; I will smooth them away like mud in the streets.
verses.display_text:
And I will grind them fine like dust before the wind;
I will smooth them away like mud in the streets.

verses.text: Thou wilt rescue me from the people’s disputes; Thou wilt appoint me head of nations; a people I did not know served me.
At the hearing of the ear, it obeyed me; foreigners lied to me.
verses.display_text:
At the hearing of the ear, it obeyed me;
foreigners lied to me.

verses.text: Foreigners grew old and limped away from their paths.
verses.display_text:
Foreigners grew old
and limped away from their paths.

verses.text: The Lord lives! Blessed be my God! Let the God of my salvation be exalted,
verses.display_text:
The Lord lives! Blessed be my God!
Let the God of my salvation be exalted,

verses.text: the God who gives me acts of vengeance and subjected peoples beneath me,
verses.display_text:
the God who gives me acts of vengeance
and subjected peoples beneath me,

verses.text: my rescuer from my wrathful enemies. Thou wilt raise me above those who rise against me; Thou wilt rescue me from an unjust man.
Therefore I will thank Thee among the nations, Lord, and sing praise to Thy name,
verses.display_text:
Therefore I will thank Thee among the nations, Lord,
and sing praise to Thy name,

verses.text: magnifying the salvations of His king and showing mercy to His anointed, to David and to his seed for ever.
verses.display_text:
magnifying the salvations of His king
and showing mercy to His anointed,
to David and to his seed for ever.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David.

verses.text: The heavens recount God’s glory, and the firmament announces the work of His hands.
verses.display_text:
The heavens recount God’s glory,
and the firmament announces the work of His hands.

verses.text: Day pours forth an utterance to day, and night announces knowledge to night.
verses.display_text:
Day pours forth an utterance to day,
and night announces knowledge to night.

verses.text: There are no utterances or words whose voices are not heard.
verses.display_text:
There are no utterances or words
whose voices are not heard.

verses.text: Their sound went out into all the earth, and their utterances to the limits of the inhabited world. In the sun He set His dwelling.
verses.display_text:
Their sound went out into all the earth,
and their utterances to the limits of the inhabited world.
In the sun He set His dwelling.

verses.text: And he is like a bridegroom coming out of his bridal chamber; he will exult like a giant to run his way.
verses.display_text:
And he is like a bridegroom coming out of his bridal chamber;
he will exult like a giant to run his way.

verses.text: His going out is from heaven’s edge, and his arrival reaches heaven’s edge; there is no one who will be hidden from his heat.
The Lord’s law is blameless, turning souls; the Lord’s testimony is trustworthy, making infants wise.
verses.display_text:
The Lord’s law is blameless, turning souls;
the Lord’s testimony is trustworthy, making infants wise.

verses.text: The Lord’s ordinances are upright, rejoicing the heart; the Lord’s commandment shines afar, giving light to the eyes.
verses.display_text:
The Lord’s ordinances are upright, rejoicing the heart;
the Lord’s commandment shines afar, giving light to the eyes.

verses.text: The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring for the age of the age; the Lord’s judgments are true, justified together,
verses.display_text:
The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring for the age of the age;
the Lord’s judgments are true, justified together,

verses.text: desirable beyond gold and much precious stone, and sweeter than honey and honeycomb.
verses.display_text:
desirable beyond gold and much precious stone,
and sweeter than honey and honeycomb.

verses.text: For indeed, Thy servant keeps them; in keeping them there is great recompense.
verses.display_text:
For indeed, Thy servant keeps them;
in keeping them there is great recompense.

verses.text: Who will understand transgressions? Cleanse me of my hidden things.
verses.display_text:
Who will understand transgressions?
Cleanse me of my hidden things.

verses.text: And spare Thy servant from others; if they do not rule over me, then I will be blameless and cleansed from great sin.
And the sayings of my mouth will be pleasing, and the meditation of my heart will be before Thee continually, Lord, my helper and my redeemer.
verses.display_text:
And the sayings of my mouth will be pleasing,
and the meditation of my heart will be before Thee continually,
Lord, my helper and my redeemer.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David.

verses.text: May the Lord hear you in the day of affliction; may the name of Jacob’s God protect you.
verses.display_text:
May the Lord hear you in the day of affliction;
may the name of Jacob’s God protect you.

verses.text: May He send you help from the sanctuary and support you from Zion.
verses.display_text:
May He send you help from the sanctuary
and support you from Zion.

verses.text: May He remember every sacrifice of yours and make your whole burnt offering fat. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
May He remember every sacrifice of yours
and make your whole burnt offering fat.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: May He give you according to your heart and fulfill all your counsel.
verses.display_text:
May He give you according to your heart
and fulfill all your counsel.

verses.text: We will exult in your salvation, and in our God’s name we will be magnified. May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.
verses.display_text:
We will exult in your salvation,
and in our God’s name we will be magnified.
May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.

verses.text: Now I know that the Lord saved His anointed; He will hear him from His holy heaven; in mighty acts is the salvation of His right hand.
These rely on chariots, and those on horses, but we will be magnified in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.display_text:
These rely on chariots, and those on horses,
but we will be magnified in the name of the Lord our God.

verses.text: They were fettered and fell, but we rose and were set upright.
verses.display_text:
They were fettered and fell,
but we rose and were set upright.

verses.text: Lord, save Thy king, and hear us on whatever day we call upon Thee.
verses.display_text:
Lord, save Thy king,
and hear us on whatever day we call upon Thee.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David.

verses.text: Lord, the king will rejoice in Thy power and exult greatly in Thy salvation.
verses.display_text:
Lord, the king will rejoice in Thy power
and exult greatly in Thy salvation.

verses.text: Thou gavest him the desire of his soul and didst not deprive him of the wish of his lips. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Thou gavest him the desire of his soul
and didst not deprive him of the wish of his lips.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: For Thou didst meet him with blessings of kindness; Thou didst place upon his head a crown of precious stone.
verses.display_text:
For Thou didst meet him with blessings of kindness;
Thou didst place upon his head a crown of precious stone.

verses.text: He asked Thee for life, and Thou gavest it to him, length of days for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
He asked Thee for life, and Thou gavest it to him,
length of days for the age of the age.

verses.text: His glory is great in Thy salvation; Thou wilt bestow glory and magnificence upon him.
verses.display_text:
His glory is great in Thy salvation;
Thou wilt bestow glory and magnificence upon him.

verses.text: For Thou wilt give him blessing for the age of the age; Thou wilt gladden him with joy in Thy presence.
verses.display_text:
For Thou wilt give him blessing for the age of the age;
Thou wilt gladden him with joy in Thy presence.

verses.text: For the king hopes in the Lord, and through the Most High’s mercy he will certainly not be shaken.
verses.display_text:
For the king hopes in the Lord,
and through the Most High’s mercy he will certainly not be shaken.

verses.text: May your hand be found by all your enemies; may your right hand find all who hate you.
verses.display_text:
May your hand be found by all your enemies;
may your right hand find all who hate you.

verses.text: You will make them like a fiery furnace at the time of your presence; the Lord in His anger will throw them into turmoil, and fire will devour them.
You will destroy their fruit from the earth and their seed from the sons of men,
verses.display_text:
You will destroy their fruit from the earth
and their seed from the sons of men,

verses.text: because they directed evils against you; they devised a counsel they will certainly be unable to establish.
verses.display_text:
because they directed evils against you;
they devised a counsel they will certainly be unable to establish.

verses.text: For you will make them turn their backs; among your remaining ones you will prepare their face.
verses.display_text:
For you will make them turn their backs;
among your remaining ones you will prepare their face.

verses.text: Be exalted, Lord, in Thy power; we will sing and make music of Thy mighty acts.
verses.display_text:
Be exalted, Lord, in Thy power;
we will sing and make music of Thy mighty acts.

verses.text: For the end, concerning the help of the morning. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end, concerning the help of the morning. A psalm of David.

verses.text: God, my God, attend to me; why didst Thou abandon me? Far from my salvation are the words of my transgressions.
verses.display_text:
God, my God, attend to me; why didst Thou abandon me?
Far from my salvation are the words of my transgressions.

verses.text: My God, I will cry by day, and Thou wilt not hear, and by night, and not to folly for me.
verses.display_text:
My God, I will cry by day, and Thou wilt not hear,
and by night, and not to folly for me.

verses.text: But Thou dwellest among holy ones, the praise of Israel.
verses.display_text:
But Thou dwellest among holy ones,
the praise of Israel.

verses.text: In Thee our fathers hoped; they hoped, and Thou didst rescue them.
verses.display_text:
In Thee our fathers hoped;
they hoped, and Thou didst rescue them.

verses.text: To Thee they cried out and were saved; in Thee they hoped and were not put to shame.
verses.display_text:
To Thee they cried out and were saved;
in Thee they hoped and were not put to shame.

verses.text: But I am a worm and not a human being, a human reproach and an object of the people’s contempt.
verses.display_text:
But I am a worm and not a human being,
a human reproach and an object of the people’s contempt.

verses.text: All who watch me sneered at me; they spoke with their lips and shook their heads:
verses.display_text:
All who watch me sneered at me;
they spoke with their lips and shook their heads:

verses.text: “He hoped in the Lord; let Him rescue him; let Him save him, since He desires him.”
verses.display_text:
“He hoped in the Lord; let Him rescue him;
let Him save him, since He desires him.”

verses.text: For Thou art the One who drew me from the belly, my hope from my mother’s breasts.
verses.display_text:
For Thou art the One who drew me from the belly,
my hope from my mother’s breasts.

verses.text: Upon Thee I was cast from the womb; from my mother’s belly Thou art my God.
verses.display_text:
Upon Thee I was cast from the womb;
from my mother’s belly Thou art my God.

verses.text: Do not stand away from me, for affliction is near, for there is no one to help.
verses.display_text:
Do not stand away from me, for affliction is near,
for there is no one to help.

verses.text: Many calves surrounded me; fat bulls encompassed me.
verses.display_text:
Many calves surrounded me;
fat bulls encompassed me.

verses.text: They opened their mouth against me like a lion seizing prey and roaring.
verses.display_text:
They opened their mouth against me
like a lion seizing prey and roaring.

verses.text: I was poured out like water, and all my bones were scattered. My heart became like wax melting in the midst of my belly.
verses.display_text:
I was poured out like water,
and all my bones were scattered.
My heart became like wax
melting in the midst of my belly.

verses.text: My strength dried up like a potsherd; my tongue is stuck to my throat, and Thou broughtest me down into the dust of death.
For many dogs surrounded me; a gathering of evildoers encompassed me; they dug into my hands and feet.
I counted all my bones; but they observed and looked upon me.
verses.display_text:
I counted all my bones;
but they observed and looked upon me.

verses.text: They divided my garments among themselves, and cast a lot for my clothing.
verses.display_text:
They divided my garments among themselves,
and cast a lot for my clothing.

verses.text: But Thou, Lord, do not put my help far away; attend to my support.
verses.display_text:
But Thou, Lord, do not put my help far away;
attend to my support.

verses.text: Rescue my soul from the sword and my only one from the dog’s hand.
verses.display_text:
Rescue my soul from the sword
and my only one from the dog’s hand.

verses.text: Save me from a lion’s mouth and my lowliness from the horns of one-horned animals.
verses.display_text:
Save me from a lion’s mouth
and my lowliness from the horns of one-horned animals.

verses.text: I will recount Thy name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will sing hymns unto Thee:
verses.display_text:
I will recount Thy name to my brothers;
in the midst of the assembly I will sing hymns unto Thee:

verses.text: You who fear the Lord, praise Him! All Jacob’s seed, glorify Him! Let all Israel’s seed fear Him,
verses.display_text:
You who fear the Lord, praise Him!
All Jacob’s seed, glorify Him!
Let all Israel’s seed fear Him,

verses.text: because He did not despise or resent the poor man’s petition, nor turn His face away from me, and when I cried out to Him, He heard me.
verses.display_text:
because He did not despise or resent the poor man’s petition,
nor turn His face away from me,
and when I cried out to Him, He heard me.

verses.text: From Thee comes my praise in a great assembly; I will repay my vows before those who fear Him.
verses.display_text:
From Thee comes my praise in a great assembly;
I will repay my vows before those who fear Him.

verses.text: The needy will eat and be filled, and those who seek the Lord will praise Him; their hearts will live for the age of the age.
All the limits of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the families of the nations will bow down before Thee,
verses.display_text:
All the limits of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord,
and all the families of the nations will bow down before Thee,

verses.text: because kingship belongs to the Lord, and He is master of the nations.
verses.display_text:
because kingship belongs to the Lord,
and He is master of the nations.

verses.text: All the prosperous of the earth ate and bowed down; before Him all who descend into the earth will fall, and my soul lives for Him.
And my seed will serve Him; the coming generation will be announced to the Lord,
verses.display_text:
And my seed will serve Him;
the coming generation will be announced to the Lord,

verses.text: and they will announce His righteousness to a people yet to be born, because the Lord has done it.
verses.display_text:
and they will announce His righteousness
to a people yet to be born,
because the Lord has done it.

verses.text: A psalm of David. The Lord shepherds me, and nothing shall fail me.
verses.display_text:
A psalm of David.
The Lord shepherds me, and nothing shall fail me.

verses.text: He made me dwell in a place of green growth; He nourished me beside water of rest.
verses.display_text:
He made me dwell in a place of green growth;
He nourished me beside water of rest.

verses.text: He turned my soul back; He guided me upon paths of righteousness for His name’s sake.
For even if I walk in the midst of death’s shadow, I will fear no evils, for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff comforted me.
Thou didst prepare a table before me opposite those who afflict me; Thou didst enrich my head with oil, and Thy cup is intoxicating—how excellent!
And Thy mercy will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the Lord’s house for length of days.
verses.display_text:
And Thy mercy will pursue me all the days of my life,
and I will dwell in the Lord’s house for length of days.

verses.text: A psalm of David, for the first day of the week. The earth and its fullness belong to the Lord, the inhabited world and all who dwell in it.
verses.display_text:
A psalm of David, for the first day of the week.
The earth and its fullness belong to the Lord,
the inhabited world and all who dwell in it.

verses.text: He founded it upon seas and prepared it upon rivers.
verses.display_text:
He founded it upon seas
and prepared it upon rivers.

verses.text: Who will ascend the Lord’s mountain, and who will stand in His holy place?
verses.display_text:
Who will ascend the Lord’s mountain,
and who will stand in His holy place?

verses.text: One innocent in hands and pure in heart, who did not take up his soul for emptiness and did not swear deceitfully to his neighbor.
verses.display_text:
One innocent in hands and pure in heart,
who did not take up his soul for emptiness
and did not swear deceitfully to his neighbor.

verses.text: This one will receive blessing from the Lord and mercy from God his Savior.
verses.display_text:
This one will receive blessing from the Lord
and mercy from God his Savior.

verses.text: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek the face of Jacob’s God. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
This is the generation of those who seek Him,
who seek the face of Jacob’s God.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: Your rulers—lift up gates! And be raised, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
verses.display_text:
Your rulers—lift up gates!
And be raised, eternal gates,
and the King of glory will enter.

verses.text: Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and powerful; the Lord, powerful in war.
Your rulers—lift up gates! And be raised, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
verses.display_text:
Your rulers—lift up gates!
And be raised, eternal gates,
and the King of glory will enter.

verses.text: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of powers—He is the King of glory.
verses.display_text:
Who is this King of glory?
The Lord of powers—He is the King of glory.

verses.text: A psalm of David. To Thee, Lord, I lifted my soul, my God.
verses.display_text:
A psalm of David.
To Thee, Lord, I lifted my soul, my God.

verses.text: In Thee I have trusted; may I not be put to shame, and let my enemies not laugh at me.
verses.display_text:
In Thee I have trusted; may I not be put to shame,
and let my enemies not laugh at me.

verses.text: For indeed, all who wait for Thee will certainly not be put to shame; let all who act lawlessly without cause be ashamed.
verses.display_text:
For indeed, all who wait for Thee will certainly not be put to shame;
let all who act lawlessly without cause be ashamed.

verses.text: Make Thy ways known to me, Lord, and teach me Thy paths.
verses.display_text:
Make Thy ways known to me, Lord,
and teach me Thy paths.

verses.text: Guide me into Thy truth and teach me, for Thou art God my Savior, and I waited for Thee the whole day.
verses.display_text:
Guide me into Thy truth
and teach me, for Thou art God my Savior,
and I waited for Thee the whole day.

verses.text: Remember Thy compassions, Lord, and Thy mercies, for they are from eternity.
verses.display_text:
Remember Thy compassions, Lord,
and Thy mercies, for they are from eternity.

verses.text: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my acts of ignorance; according to Thy mercy, remember me Thyself, for Thy kindness’ sake, Lord.
The Lord is kind and upright; therefore He will give sinners instruction in the way.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is kind and upright;
therefore He will give sinners instruction in the way.

verses.text: He will guide the meek in judgment; He will teach the meek His ways.
verses.display_text:
He will guide the meek in judgment;
He will teach the meek His ways.

verses.text: All the Lord’s ways are mercy and truth for those who seek His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.display_text:
All the Lord’s ways are mercy and truth
for those who seek His covenant and His testimonies.

verses.text: For Thy name’s sake, Lord, Thou wilt be gracious to my sin, for it is great.
verses.display_text:
For Thy name’s sake, Lord,
Thou wilt be gracious to my sin, for it is great.

verses.text: Who is the human being who fears the Lord? He will give him instruction in a way he chose.
verses.display_text:
Who is the human being who fears the Lord?
He will give him instruction in a way he chose.

verses.text: His soul will lodge among good things, and his seed will inherit land.
verses.display_text:
His soul will lodge among good things,
and his seed will inherit land.

verses.text: The Lord is the stronghold of those who fear Him, and the Lord’s name belongs to those who fear Him, and His covenant is to make things known to them.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is the stronghold of those who fear Him,
and the Lord’s name belongs to those who fear Him,
and His covenant is to make things known to them.

verses.text: My eyes are continually toward the Lord, for He will pull my feet out of a trap.
verses.display_text:
My eyes are continually toward the Lord,
for He will pull my feet out of a trap.

verses.text: Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and poor.
verses.display_text:
Look upon me and have mercy on me,
for I am alone and poor.

verses.text: The afflictions of my heart widened; bring me out of my distresses.
verses.display_text:
The afflictions of my heart widened;
bring me out of my distresses.

verses.text: See my humiliation and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
verses.display_text:
See my humiliation and my toil,
and forgive all my sins.

verses.text: See my enemies, for they multiplied and hated me with unjust hatred.
verses.display_text:
See my enemies, for they multiplied
and hated me with unjust hatred.

verses.text: Guard my soul and rescue me; may I not be put to shame, for I hoped in Thee.
verses.display_text:
Guard my soul and rescue me;
may I not be put to shame, for I hoped in Thee.

verses.text: Innocent and upright people clung to me, for I waited for Thee, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Innocent and upright people clung to me,
for I waited for Thee, Lord.

verses.text: Redeem Israel, God, from all its afflictions.
verses.display_text:
Redeem Israel, God,
from all its afflictions.

verses.text: Of David. Judge me, Lord, for I walked in my innocence, and hoping in the Lord, I will certainly not grow weak.
verses.display_text:
Of David.
Judge me, Lord, for I walked in my innocence,
and hoping in the Lord, I will certainly not grow weak.

verses.text: Test me, Lord, and try me; try my kidneys and my heart by fire.
verses.display_text:
Test me, Lord, and try me;
try my kidneys and my heart by fire.

verses.text: For Thy mercy is before my eyes, and I acted pleasingly in Thy truth.
verses.display_text:
For Thy mercy is before my eyes,
and I acted pleasingly in Thy truth.

verses.text: I did not sit with a council of emptiness, and I will certainly not enter with transgressors.
verses.display_text:
I did not sit with a council of emptiness,
and I will certainly not enter with transgressors.

verses.text: I hated an assembly of evildoers, and I will certainly not sit with the ungodly.
verses.display_text:
I hated an assembly of evildoers,
and I will certainly not sit with the ungodly.

verses.text: I will wash my hands among the innocent and go around Thine altar, Lord,
verses.display_text:
I will wash my hands among the innocent
and go around Thine altar, Lord,

verses.text: to hear a voice of praise and recount all Thy wonders.
verses.display_text:
to hear a voice of praise
and recount all Thy wonders.

verses.text: Lord, I loved the beauty of Thy house and the place of Thy glory’s dwelling.
verses.display_text:
Lord, I loved the beauty of Thy house
and the place of Thy glory’s dwelling.

verses.text: Do not destroy my soul together with the ungodly, or my life with men of bloodshed,
verses.display_text:
Do not destroy my soul together with the ungodly,
or my life with men of bloodshed,

verses.text: in whose hands are lawless deeds; their right hand was filled with gifts.
verses.display_text:
in whose hands are lawless deeds;
their right hand was filled with gifts.

verses.text: But I walked in my innocence; redeem me and have mercy on me.
verses.display_text:
But I walked in my innocence;
redeem me and have mercy on me.

verses.text: For my foot stood in uprightness; in assemblies I will bless Thee, Lord.
verses.display_text:
For my foot stood in uprightness;
in assemblies I will bless Thee, Lord.

verses.text: Of David, before being anointed. The Lord is my light and my Savior; whom will I fear? The Lord is the protector of my life; of whom will I be afraid?
verses.display_text:
Of David, before being anointed.
The Lord is my light and my Savior; whom will I fear?
The Lord is the protector of my life; of whom will I be afraid?

verses.text: When those doing evil approached me to eat my flesh, those who afflict me and my enemies, they grew weak and fell.
verses.display_text:
When those doing evil approached me to eat my flesh,
those who afflict me and my enemies,
they grew weak and fell.

verses.text: Even if an army draws up against me, my heart will not fear; even if war rises against me, in this I hope.
verses.display_text:
Even if an army draws up against me, my heart will not fear;
even if war rises against me, in this I hope.

verses.text: One thing I asked from the Lord; this I will seek: that I may dwell in the Lord’s house all the days of my life, that I may behold the Lord’s loveliness and visit His temple.
verses.display_text:
One thing I asked from the Lord; this I will seek:
that I may dwell in the Lord’s house all the days of my life,
that I may behold the Lord’s loveliness
and visit His temple.

verses.text: For He hid me in a tent in the day of my troubles; He sheltered me in the hiding place of His tent; He raised me upon a rock.
And now, behold, He raised my head above my enemies; I went around and sacrificed in His tent a sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and make music to the Lord.
Hear, Lord, my voice with which I cried; have mercy on me and hear me.
verses.display_text:
Hear, Lord, my voice with which I cried;
have mercy on me and hear me.

verses.text: My heart said unto Thee, “My face sought Thee.” Thy face, Lord, I will seek.
verses.display_text:
My heart said unto Thee, “My face sought Thee.”
Thy face, Lord, I will seek.

verses.text: Do not turn Thy face away from me; do not turn aside in anger from Thy servant. Become my helper; do not reject me or abandon me, God my Savior.
verses.display_text:
Do not turn Thy face away from me;
do not turn aside in anger from Thy servant.
Become my helper; do not reject me
or abandon me, God my Savior.

verses.text: For my father and my mother abandoned me, but the Lord took me to Himself.
verses.display_text:
For my father and my mother abandoned me,
but the Lord took me to Himself.

verses.text: Give me instruction in Thy way, Lord, and guide me on an upright path because of my enemies.
verses.display_text:
Give me instruction in Thy way, Lord,
and guide me on an upright path because of my enemies.

verses.text: Do not hand me over to the souls of those who afflict me, for unjust witnesses rose against me, and injustice lied to itself.
I believe that I will see the Lord’s good things in the land of the living.
verses.display_text: I believe that I will see the Lord’s good things in the land of the living.

verses.text: Wait for the Lord; act courageously, and let your heart be strong, and wait for the Lord.
Of David. To Thee, Lord, I cried; my God, do not keep silence toward me, lest Thou keep silence toward me and I become like those descending into a pit.
verses.display_text:
Of David.
To Thee, Lord, I cried;
my God, do not keep silence toward me,
lest Thou keep silence toward me
and I become like those descending into a pit.

verses.text: Hear the voice of my petition as I petition Thee, as I lift my hands toward Thy holy temple.
verses.display_text:
Hear the voice of my petition as I petition Thee,
as I lift my hands toward Thy holy temple.

verses.text: Do not drag my soul away together with sinners, and do not destroy me together with those working injustice, who speak peace with their neighbors while evils are in their hearts.
verses.display_text:
Do not drag my soul away together with sinners,
and do not destroy me together with those working injustice,
who speak peace with their neighbors
while evils are in their hearts.

verses.text: Give them according to their works and according to the wickedness of their practices; give them according to the works of their hands; repay their recompense to them.
Because they did not understand the Lord’s works or the works of His hands, Thou wilt pull them down and certainly not build them up.
verses.display_text:
Because they did not understand the Lord’s works
or the works of His hands,
Thou wilt pull them down and certainly not build them up.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, because He heard the voice of my petition.
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord,
because He heard the voice of my petition.

verses.text: The Lord is my helper and my protector; in Him my heart hoped, and I was helped, and my flesh blossomed anew; from my own will I will thank Him.
The Lord is the stronghold of His people and the protector of the salvations of His anointed.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is the stronghold of His people
and the protector of the salvations of His anointed.

verses.text: Save Thy people and bless Thine inheritance; shepherd them and lift them up for ever.
verses.display_text:
Save Thy people and bless Thine inheritance;
shepherd them and lift them up for ever.

verses.text: A psalm of David, for the departure of the tent. Bring to the Lord, sons of God; bring to the Lord young rams; bring to the Lord glory and honor.
Bring to the Lord glory for His name; bow down to the Lord in His holy courtyard.
verses.display_text:
Bring to the Lord glory for His name;
bow down to the Lord in His holy courtyard.

verses.text: The Lord’s voice is over the waters; the God of glory thundered; the Lord is over many waters.
The Lord’s voice is in strength; the Lord’s voice is in magnificence.
verses.display_text:
The Lord’s voice is in strength;
the Lord’s voice is in magnificence.

verses.text: The voice of the Lord, who crushes cedars; and the Lord will crush Lebanon’s cedars,
verses.display_text:
The voice of the Lord, who crushes cedars;
and the Lord will crush Lebanon’s cedars,

verses.text: and He will grind them fine—Lebanon like the calf— and the beloved like a young one-horned animal.
verses.display_text:
and He will grind them fine—Lebanon like the calf—
and the beloved like a young one-horned animal.

verses.text: The voice of the Lord, who cleaves a flame of fire.
verses.display_text: The voice of the Lord, who cleaves a flame of fire.

verses.text: The voice of the Lord, who shakes the wilderness; and the Lord will shake the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.display_text:
