The voice of the Lord, who shakes the wilderness;
and the Lord will shake the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.text: The voice of the Lord, who makes deer ready; and He will uncover forests; in His temple everyone speaks glory.
The Lord will settle the flood, and the Lord sits as King for ever.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will settle the flood,
and the Lord sits as King for ever.

verses.text: The Lord will give strength to His people; the Lord will bless His people with peace.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will give strength to His people;
the Lord will bless His people with peace.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of a song for the dedication of the house. Of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of a song for the dedication of the house. Of David.

verses.text: I will exalt Thee, Lord, for Thou tookest me up and didst not gladden my enemies over me.
verses.display_text:
I will exalt Thee, Lord, for Thou tookest me up
and didst not gladden my enemies over me.

verses.text: Lord my God, I cried out unto Thee, and Thou didst heal me.
verses.display_text:
Lord my God, I cried out unto Thee,
and Thou didst heal me.

verses.text: Lord, Thou broughtest my soul up from Hades; Thou didst save me from those descending into a pit.
verses.display_text:
Lord, Thou broughtest my soul up from Hades;
Thou didst save me from those descending into a pit.

verses.text: Sing praise to the Lord, His holy ones, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness,
verses.display_text:
Sing praise to the Lord, His holy ones,
and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness,

verses.text: because anger is in His wrath, and life in His will; weeping will lodge in the evening, and exultation comes toward morning.
verses.display_text:
because anger is in His wrath,
and life in His will;
weeping will lodge in the evening,
and exultation comes toward morning.

verses.text: But I said in my prosperity, “I will certainly never be shaken.”
verses.display_text:
But I said in my prosperity,
“I will certainly never be shaken.”

verses.text: Lord, in Thy will Thou didst supply strength to my beauty; but Thou didst turn Thy face away, and I became troubled.
verses.display_text:
Lord, in Thy will Thou didst supply strength to my beauty;
but Thou didst turn Thy face away, and I became troubled.

verses.text: To Thee, Lord, I will cry, and to my God I will make my petition:
verses.display_text:
To Thee, Lord, I will cry,
and to my God I will make my petition:

verses.text: “What benefit is there in my blood, in my descending into corruption? Will dust give thanks unto Thee, or announce Thy truth?”
verses.display_text:
“What benefit is there in my blood,
in my descending into corruption?
Will dust give thanks unto Thee,
or announce Thy truth?”

verses.text: The Lord heard and had mercy on me; the Lord became my helper.
verses.display_text:
The Lord heard and had mercy on me;
the Lord became my helper.

verses.text: Thou didst turn my lament into dancing for me; Thou didst tear open my sackcloth and gird me with gladness,
verses.display_text:
Thou didst turn my lament into dancing for me;
Thou didst tear open my sackcloth and gird me with gladness,

verses.text: so that my glory may sing praise unto Thee, and I may certainly not be pierced with grief. Lord my God, I will thank Thee for ever.
verses.display_text:
so that my glory may sing praise unto Thee,
and I may certainly not be pierced with grief.
Lord my God, I will thank Thee for ever.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David, of alarm.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David, of alarm.

verses.text: In Thee, Lord, I hoped; may I never be put to shame; in Thy righteousness rescue me and bring me out.
verses.display_text:
In Thee, Lord, I hoped; may I never be put to shame;
in Thy righteousness rescue me and bring me out.

verses.text: Incline Thine ear to me; hasten to bring me out; be for me a protecting God and a house of refuge to save me.
For Thou art my stronghold and my refuge, and for Thy name’s sake Thou wilt guide me and nourish me.
verses.display_text:
For Thou art my stronghold and my refuge,
and for Thy name’s sake Thou wilt guide me and nourish me.

verses.text: Thou wilt bring me out of this trap they hid for me, for Thou art my protector.
verses.display_text:
Thou wilt bring me out of this trap they hid for me,
for Thou art my protector.

verses.text: Into Thy hands I will entrust my spirit; Thou didst redeem me, Lord, God of truth.
verses.display_text:
Into Thy hands I will entrust my spirit;
Thou didst redeem me, Lord, God of truth.

verses.text: Thou didst hate those who guard vanities to no purpose; but I hoped in the Lord.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst hate those who guard vanities to no purpose;
but I hoped in the Lord.

verses.text: I will exult and rejoice in Thy mercy, because Thou didst look upon my humiliation; Thou didst save my soul from constraints
and didst not enclose me in an enemy’s hands; Thou didst set my feet in a spacious place.
verses.display_text:
and didst not enclose me in an enemy’s hands;
Thou didst set my feet in a spacious place.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am afflicted; my eye was troubled with anger, my soul and my belly too.
For my life failed in pain and my years in groaning; my strength grew weak in poverty, and my bones were troubled.
verses.display_text:
For my life failed in pain
and my years in groaning;
my strength grew weak in poverty,
and my bones were troubled.

verses.text: Beyond all my enemies I became a reproach, and greatly so to my neighbors, and a fear to my acquaintances; those who watched me outside fled from me.
verses.display_text:
Beyond all my enemies I became a reproach,
and greatly so to my neighbors,
and a fear to my acquaintances;
those who watched me outside fled from me.

verses.text: I was forgotten from the heart like a dead person; I became like a lost vessel.
verses.display_text:
I was forgotten from the heart like a dead person;
I became like a lost vessel.

verses.text: For I heard the reproach of many dwelling all around; as they gathered together against me, they planned to take my soul.
But I hoped in Thee, Lord; I said, “Thou art my God.”
verses.display_text:
But I hoped in Thee, Lord;
I said, “Thou art my God.”

verses.text: My seasons are in Thy hands; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who pursue me.
Make Thy face shine upon Thy servant; save me in Thy mercy.
verses.display_text:
Make Thy face shine upon Thy servant;
save me in Thy mercy.

verses.text: Lord, may I not be put to shame, for I called upon Thee; may the ungodly be ashamed and brought down to Hades.
verses.display_text:
Lord, may I not be put to shame, for I called upon Thee;
may the ungodly be ashamed and brought down to Hades.

verses.text: Let deceitful lips become speechless, those that speak lawlessness against the righteous in arrogance and contempt.
verses.display_text:
Let deceitful lips become speechless,
those that speak lawlessness against the righteous
in arrogance and contempt.

verses.text: How great is the multitude of Thy kindness, Lord, which Thou didst conceal for those who fear Thee, which Thou didst accomplish for those who hope in Thee before the sons of men!
verses.display_text:
How great is the multitude of Thy kindness, Lord,
which Thou didst conceal for those who fear Thee,
which Thou didst accomplish for those who hope in Thee
before the sons of men!

verses.text: Thou wilt hide them in the hiding place of Thy presence from human turmoil; Thou wilt shelter them in a tent from the contradiction of tongues.
verses.display_text:
Thou wilt hide them in the hiding place of Thy presence from human turmoil;
Thou wilt shelter them in a tent from the contradiction of tongues.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, because He made His mercy wonderful in an enclosed city.
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord,
because He made His mercy wonderful in an enclosed city.

verses.text: But I said in my alarm, “So I have been cast away from before Thine eyes.” For this reason Thou heardest the voice of my petition when I cried unto Thee.
verses.display_text:
But I said in my alarm,
“So I have been cast away from before Thine eyes.”
For this reason Thou heardest the voice of my petition when I cried unto Thee.

verses.text: Love the Lord, all His holy ones, because the Lord seeks truths and repays those who act with abundant arrogance.
verses.display_text:
Love the Lord, all His holy ones,
because the Lord seeks truths
and repays those who act with abundant arrogance.

verses.text: Act courageously, and let your heart be strong, all who hope in the Lord.
verses.display_text:
Act courageously, and let your heart be strong,
all who hope in the Lord.

verses.text: Of David. Of understanding. Blessed are those whose lawless deeds are forgiven and whose sins are covered.
verses.display_text:
Of David. Of understanding.
Blessed are those whose lawless deeds are forgiven
and whose sins are covered.

verses.text: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will certainly not reckon, and in whose mouth there is no deceit.
verses.display_text:
Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will certainly not reckon,
and in whose mouth there is no deceit.

verses.text: Because I kept silent, my bones grew old from my crying out all day long.
verses.display_text:
Because I kept silent, my bones grew old
from my crying out all day long.

verses.text: For day and night Thy hand weighed heavily upon me; I was turned to misery when a thorn became lodged. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
For day and night Thy hand weighed heavily upon me;
I was turned to misery when a thorn became lodged. Diapsalma.

verses.text: I made my sin known, and I did not cover my lawlessness. I said, “I will confess my lawlessness against myself to the Lord,” and Thou forgavest the impiety of my sin. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
I made my sin known,
and I did not cover my lawlessness.
I said, “I will confess my lawlessness against myself to the Lord,”
and Thou forgavest the impiety of my sin. Diapsalma.

verses.text: For this every holy one will pray unto Thee at a fitting time; yet in a flood of many waters they will not approach him.
verses.display_text:
For this every holy one will pray unto Thee at a fitting time;
yet in a flood of many waters they will not approach him.

verses.text: Thou art my refuge from the affliction surrounding me; my exultation, redeem me from those who have encircled me. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Thou art my refuge from the affliction surrounding me;
my exultation, redeem me from those who have encircled me. Diapsalma.

verses.text: I will give you understanding and instruct you in this way in which you will go; I will fix my eyes upon you.
verses.display_text:
I will give you understanding and instruct you in this way in which you will go;
I will fix my eyes upon you.

verses.text: Do not become like a horse and mule that have no understanding; with bridle and muzzle tighten their jaws— those that do not approach you.
Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy will surround the one who hopes in the Lord.
verses.display_text:
Many are the scourges of the sinner,
but mercy will surround the one who hopes in the Lord.

verses.text: Rejoice in the Lord and exult, righteous ones; boast, all upright in heart.
verses.display_text:
Rejoice in the Lord and exult, righteous ones;
boast, all upright in heart.

verses.text: Of David. Exult in the Lord, righteous ones; praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre; make music to Him with a ten-stringed psaltery.
verses.display_text:
Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre;
make music to Him with a ten-stringed psaltery.

verses.text: Sing Him a new song; make music well with a shout of triumph.
verses.display_text:
Sing Him a new song;
make music well with a shout of triumph.

verses.text: For the Lord’s word is upright, and all His works are in faithfulness.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord’s word is upright,
and all His works are in faithfulness.

verses.text: He loves mercy and judgment; the earth is full of the Lord’s mercy.
verses.display_text:
He loves mercy and judgment;
the earth is full of the Lord’s mercy.

verses.text: By the Lord’s word the heavens were established, and by the spirit of His mouth all their power.
verses.display_text:
By the Lord’s word the heavens were established,
and by the spirit of His mouth all their power.

verses.text: He gathers the sea’s waters like a wineskin; He places the deeps in storehouses.
verses.display_text:
He gathers the sea’s waters like a wineskin;
He places the deeps in storehouses.

verses.text: Let all the earth fear the Lord; let all who inhabit the world be shaken before Him.
verses.display_text:
Let all the earth fear the Lord;
let all who inhabit the world be shaken before Him.

verses.text: For He spoke, and they came to be; He commanded, and they were created.
verses.display_text:
For He spoke, and they came to be;
He commanded, and they were created.

verses.text: The Lord scatters the counsels of nations; He nullifies the plans of peoples and nullifies the counsels of rulers.
But the Lord’s counsel remains for ever, the plans of His heart from generation to generation.
verses.display_text:
But the Lord’s counsel remains for ever,
the plans of His heart from generation to generation.

verses.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people He chose as an inheritance for Himself.
verses.display_text:
Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord,
the people He chose as an inheritance for Himself.

verses.text: From heaven the Lord looked down; He saw all the sons of men.
verses.display_text:
From heaven the Lord looked down;
He saw all the sons of men.

verses.text: From His prepared dwelling place He looked upon all who inhabit the earth.
verses.display_text:
From His prepared dwelling place He looked
upon all who inhabit the earth.

verses.text: He formed their hearts individually; He understands all their deeds.
verses.display_text:
He formed their hearts individually;
He understands all their deeds.

verses.text: A king is not saved through a great force, and a giant will not be saved by the abundance of his strength.
verses.display_text:
A king is not saved through a great force,
and a giant will not be saved by the abundance of his strength.

verses.text: A horse is false for salvation, and by the abundance of its power it will not be saved.
verses.display_text:
A horse is false for salvation,
and by the abundance of its power it will not be saved.

verses.text: Behold, the Lord’s eyes are upon those who fear Him, those who hope in His mercy,
verses.display_text:
Behold, the Lord’s eyes are upon those who fear Him,
those who hope in His mercy,

verses.text: to rescue their souls from death and nourish them in famine.
verses.display_text:
to rescue their souls from death
and nourish them in famine.

verses.text: Our soul waits for the Lord, for He is our helper and defender.
verses.display_text:
Our soul waits for the Lord,
for He is our helper and defender.

verses.text: For our heart will rejoice in Him, and we have hoped in His holy name.
verses.display_text:
For our heart will rejoice in Him,
and we have hoped in His holy name.

verses.text: May Thy mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we have hoped in Thee.
verses.display_text:
May Thy mercy, Lord, be upon us,
just as we have hoped in Thee.

verses.text: Of David, when he altered his face before Abimelech, who dismissed him, and he went away.
verses.display_text:
Of David, when he altered his face before Abimelech,
who dismissed him, and he went away.

verses.text: I will bless the Lord at every time; His praise is continually in my mouth.
verses.display_text:
I will bless the Lord at every time;
His praise is continually in my mouth.

verses.text: My soul will be praised in the Lord; let the meek hear and rejoice.
verses.display_text:
My soul will be praised in the Lord;
let the meek hear and rejoice.

verses.text: Magnify the Lord with me; let us exalt His name together.
verses.display_text:
Magnify the Lord with me;
let us exalt His name together.

verses.text: I sought the Lord, and He heard me; from all my sojourns He rescued me.
verses.display_text:
I sought the Lord, and He heard me;
from all my sojourns He rescued me.

verses.text: Approach Him and be enlightened, and your faces will certainly not be put to shame.
verses.display_text:
Approach Him and be enlightened,
and your faces will certainly not be put to shame.

verses.text: This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him; from all his afflictions He saved him.
verses.display_text:
This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him;
from all his afflictions He saved him.

verses.text: An angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear Him and will rescue them.
verses.display_text:
An angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear Him
and will rescue them.

verses.text: Taste and see that the Lord is kind; blessed is the man who hopes in Him.
verses.display_text:
Taste and see that the Lord is kind;
blessed is the man who hopes in Him.

verses.text: Fear the Lord, His holy ones, for there is no deficiency for those who fear Him.
verses.display_text:
Fear the Lord, His holy ones,
for there is no deficiency for those who fear Him.

verses.text: Rich people became poor and hungry, but those who seek the Lord will not lack any good thing. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Rich people became poor and hungry,
but those who seek the Lord will not lack any good thing. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.display_text:
Come, children, listen to me;
I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.text: Who is the person who desires life, who loves to see good days?
verses.display_text:
Who is the person who desires life,
who loves to see good days?

verses.text: Stop your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.display_text:
Stop your tongue from evil
and your lips from speaking deceit.

verses.text: Turn aside from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.display_text:
Turn aside from evil and do good;
seek peace and pursue it.

verses.text: The Lord’s eyes are upon the righteous, and His ears toward their supplication.
verses.display_text:
The Lord’s eyes are upon the righteous,
and His ears toward their supplication.

verses.text: But the Lord’s face is against those who do evil, to destroy their remembrance from the earth.
verses.display_text:
But the Lord’s face is against those who do evil,
to destroy their remembrance from the earth.

verses.text: The righteous cried out, and the Lord heard them; from all their afflictions He rescued them.
verses.display_text:
The righteous cried out, and the Lord heard them;
from all their afflictions He rescued them.

verses.text: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted, and He will save the humble in spirit.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is near to the brokenhearted,
and He will save the humble in spirit.

verses.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, and He will rescue them from them all.
verses.display_text:
Many are the afflictions of the righteous,
and He will rescue them from them all.

verses.text: The Lord guards all their bones; not one of them will be shattered.
verses.display_text:
The Lord guards all their bones;
not one of them will be shattered.

verses.text: The death of sinners is evil, and those who hate the righteous will incur guilt.
verses.display_text:
The death of sinners is evil,
and those who hate the righteous will incur guilt.

verses.text: The Lord will redeem the souls of His servants, and none of those who hope in Him will incur guilt.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will redeem the souls of His servants,
and none of those who hope in Him will incur guilt.

verses.text: Of David. Judge, Lord, those who wrong me; make war on those who make war on me.
Take hold of weapon and shield, and rise to my aid.
verses.display_text:
Take hold of weapon and shield,
and rise to my aid.

verses.text: Draw the sword and close the way against those pursuing me; say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
verses.display_text:
Draw the sword and close the way against those pursuing me;
say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”

verses.text: Let those who seek my soul be ashamed and abashed; let those devising evils for me turn backward and be put to shame.
verses.display_text:
Let those who seek my soul be ashamed and abashed;
let those devising evils for me turn backward and be put to shame.

verses.text: Let them become like dust before the wind, with an angel of the Lord pressing them out.
verses.display_text:
Let them become like dust before the wind,
with an angel of the Lord pressing them out.

verses.text: Let their way become darkness and a slippery path, with an angel of the Lord pursuing them.
verses.display_text:
Let their way become darkness and a slippery path,
with an angel of the Lord pursuing them.

verses.text: For without cause they hid for me the destruction of their trap; without purpose they reproached my soul.
verses.display_text:
For without cause they hid for me the destruction of their trap;
without purpose they reproached my soul.

verses.text: Let a trap they do not know come upon them; let the snare they hid catch them, and into that trap they will fall.
But my soul will exult in the Lord; it will delight in His salvation.
verses.display_text:
But my soul will exult in the Lord;
it will delight in His salvation.

verses.text: All my bones will say, “Lord, who is like Thee, rescuing the poor from the hand of those stronger than he is, and the poor and needy from those plundering him?”
verses.display_text:
All my bones will say,
“Lord, who is like Thee,
rescuing the poor from the hand of those stronger than he is,
and the poor and needy from those plundering him?”

verses.text: Unjust witnesses rose up; they questioned me about what I did not know.
verses.display_text:
Unjust witnesses rose up;
they questioned me about what I did not know.

verses.text: They repaid me evils for good things, and childlessness to my soul.
verses.display_text:
They repaid me evils for good things,
and childlessness to my soul.

verses.text: But when they troubled me, I put on sackcloth and humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer will return to my bosom.
As for a neighbor, as for our brother, so I sought to please; like one mourning and downcast, so I humbled myself.
verses.display_text:
As for a neighbor, as for our brother, so I sought to please;
like one mourning and downcast, so I humbled myself.

verses.text: But against me they rejoiced and gathered; scourges gathered against me, and I did not know; they were torn apart and felt no remorse.
They tested me and mocked me with mockery; they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.display_text:
They tested me and mocked me with mockery;
they gnashed their teeth at me.

verses.text: Lord, when wilt Thou look upon this? Restore my soul from their wickedness, my only life from lions.
verses.display_text:
Lord, when wilt Thou look upon this?
Restore my soul from their wickedness,
my only life from lions.

verses.text: I will thank Thee, Lord, in a great assembly; among a weighty people I will praise Thee.
verses.display_text:
I will thank Thee, Lord, in a great assembly;
among a weighty people I will praise Thee.

verses.text: Let those unjustly hostile to me not rejoice over me, those who hate me without cause and signal with their eyes.
verses.display_text:
Let those unjustly hostile to me not rejoice over me,
those who hate me without cause and signal with their eyes.

verses.text: For to me they spoke peaceful things, but in anger they devised deceits.
verses.display_text:
For to me they spoke peaceful things,
but in anger they devised deceits.

verses.text: They opened their mouth wide against me; they said, “Well done! Well done! Our eyes have seen!”
verses.display_text:
They opened their mouth wide against me;
they said, “Well done! Well done! Our eyes have seen!”

verses.text: Thou hast seen, Lord; do not remain silent. Lord, do not depart from me.
verses.display_text:
Thou hast seen, Lord; do not remain silent.
Lord, do not depart from me.

verses.text: Awake, Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my case.
verses.display_text:
Awake, Lord, and attend to my judgment,
my God and my Lord, to my case.

verses.text: Judge me according to Thy righteousness, Lord my God; let them not rejoice over me.
verses.display_text:
Judge me according to Thy righteousness, Lord my God;
let them not rejoice over me.

verses.text: Let them not say in their hearts, “Well done! Well done for our soul!” Nor let them say, “We have swallowed him.”
verses.display_text:
Let them not say in their hearts, “Well done! Well done for our soul!”
Nor let them say, “We have swallowed him.”

verses.text: May those rejoicing at my troubles be ashamed and abashed together; let those boasting against me wear shame and humiliation.
verses.display_text:
May those rejoicing at my troubles be ashamed and abashed together;
let those boasting against me wear shame and humiliation.

verses.text: May those who desire my righteousness exult and rejoice; let them always say, “May the Lord be magnified”— those who desire His servant’s peace.
My tongue will meditate on Thy righteousness, on Thy praise all day long.
verses.display_text:
My tongue will meditate on Thy righteousness,
on Thy praise all day long.

verses.text: For the end. Of the Lord’s servant, of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. Of the Lord’s servant, of David.

verses.text: The lawless person speaks within himself of sinning; there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.display_text:
The lawless person speaks within himself of sinning;
there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.text: For he acted deceitfully in his sight, as to finding his lawlessness and hating it.
verses.display_text:
For he acted deceitfully in his sight,
as to finding his lawlessness and hating it.

verses.text: The words of his mouth are lawlessness and deceit; he was unwilling to understand so as to do good.
verses.display_text:
The words of his mouth are lawlessness and deceit;
he was unwilling to understand so as to do good.

verses.text: He devised lawlessness upon his bed; he stood by every way that was not good, and he was not offended by wickedness.
Lord, Thy mercy is in heaven, and Thy truth reaches the clouds.
verses.display_text:
Lord, Thy mercy is in heaven,
and Thy truth reaches the clouds.

verses.text: Thy righteousness is like mountains of God; Thy judgments are a great deep. Thou wilt save humans and beasts, Lord.
How Thou hast multiplied Thy mercy, God! The sons of men will hope beneath the shelter of Thy wings.
verses.display_text:
How Thou hast multiplied Thy mercy, God!
The sons of men will hope beneath the shelter of Thy wings.

verses.text: They will be intoxicated from the richness of Thy house; Thou wilt give them the torrent of Thy delight to drink.
verses.display_text:
They will be intoxicated from the richness of Thy house;
Thou wilt give them the torrent of Thy delight to drink.

verses.text: For with Thee is a fountain of life; in Thy light we will see light.
verses.display_text:
For with Thee is a fountain of life;
in Thy light we will see light.

verses.text: Extend Thy mercy to those who know Thee, and Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.display_text:
Extend Thy mercy to those who know Thee,
and Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.text: Let a foot of arrogance not come against me; let a hand of sinners not shake me.
verses.display_text:
Let a foot of arrogance not come against me;
let a hand of sinners not shake me.

verses.text: There the workers of lawlessness fell; they were expelled and will certainly not be able to stand.
verses.display_text:
There the workers of lawlessness fell;
they were expelled and will certainly not be able to stand.

verses.text: Of David. Do not be provoked to envy by those doing evil, nor envy those committing lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
Of David.
Do not be provoked to envy by those doing evil,
nor envy those committing lawlessness.

verses.text: For like grass they will quickly dry up, and like green plants they will quickly fall away.
verses.display_text:
For like grass they will quickly dry up,
and like green plants they will quickly fall away.

verses.text: Hope in the Lord and show kindness; settle in the land, and you will be pastured on its wealth.
verses.display_text:
Hope in the Lord and show kindness;
settle in the land, and you will be pastured on its wealth.

verses.text: Delight yourself in the Lord, and He will give you the requests of your heart.
verses.display_text:
Delight yourself in the Lord,
and He will give you the requests of your heart.

verses.text: Reveal your way to the Lord; hope in Him, and He will act.
verses.display_text:
Reveal your way to the Lord;
hope in Him, and He will act.

verses.text: He will bring out your righteousness like light, and your judgment like noon.
verses.display_text:
He will bring out your righteousness like light,
and your judgment like noon.

verses.text: Submit to the Lord and beseech Him; do not be provoked to envy by one prospering in his way, by a person committing lawless deeds.
Cease from anger and abandon wrath; do not be provoked to envy so as to act wickedly.
verses.display_text:
Cease from anger and abandon wrath;
do not be provoked to envy so as to act wickedly.

verses.text: For those doing evil will be destroyed, but those who wait for the Lord will inherit the land.
verses.display_text:
For those doing evil will be destroyed,
but those who wait for the Lord will inherit the land.

verses.text: A little longer, and the sinner will certainly not exist; you will seek his place and certainly not find it.
verses.display_text:
A little longer, and the sinner will certainly not exist;
you will seek his place and certainly not find it.

verses.text: But the meek will inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace.
verses.display_text:
But the meek will inherit the land
and delight themselves in abundant peace.

verses.text: The sinner will watch the righteous closely and gnash his teeth at him.
verses.display_text:
The sinner will watch the righteous closely
and gnash his teeth at him.

verses.text: But the Lord will laugh him to scorn, for He foresees that his day will come.
verses.display_text:
But the Lord will laugh him to scorn,
for He foresees that his day will come.

verses.text: The sinners drew a sword and stretched their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to slaughter the upright in heart.
verses.display_text:
The sinners drew a sword and stretched their bow,
to cast down the poor and needy,
to slaughter the upright in heart.

verses.text: May their sword enter their own heart, and may their bows be shattered.
verses.display_text:
May their sword enter their own heart,
and may their bows be shattered.

verses.text: Better is a little for the righteous than the great wealth of sinners.
verses.display_text:
Better is a little for the righteous
than the great wealth of sinners.

verses.text: For the arms of sinners will be shattered, but the Lord sustains the righteous.
verses.display_text:
For the arms of sinners will be shattered,
but the Lord sustains the righteous.

verses.text: The Lord knows the ways of the blameless, and their inheritance will last for ever.
verses.display_text:
The Lord knows the ways of the blameless,
and their inheritance will last for ever.

verses.text: They will not be put to shame in an evil time, and in days of famine they will be filled.
verses.display_text:
They will not be put to shame in an evil time,
and in days of famine they will be filled.

verses.text: For sinners will perish; the Lord’s enemies, as soon as they are glorified and exalted, vanished away like smoke—they vanished.
The sinner borrows and will not repay, but the righteous person has compassion and gives.
verses.display_text:
The sinner borrows and will not repay,
but the righteous person has compassion and gives.

verses.text: For those blessing him will inherit the land, but those cursing him will be destroyed.
verses.display_text:
For those blessing him will inherit the land,
but those cursing him will be destroyed.

verses.text: A person’s steps are directed by the Lord, and He will desire his way.
verses.display_text:
A person’s steps are directed by the Lord,
and He will desire his way.

verses.text: When he falls, he will not be dashed down, for the Lord supports his hand.
verses.display_text:
When he falls, he will not be dashed down,
for the Lord supports his hand.

verses.text: I was young and indeed have grown old, and I have not seen a righteous person abandoned or his offspring seeking loaves.
verses.display_text:
I was young and indeed have grown old,
and I have not seen a righteous person abandoned
or his offspring seeking loaves.

verses.text: All day long he shows mercy and lends, and his offspring will be a blessing.
verses.display_text:
All day long he shows mercy and lends,
and his offspring will be a blessing.

verses.text: Turn aside from evil and do good, and dwell for age upon age.
verses.display_text:
Turn aside from evil and do good,
and dwell for age upon age.

verses.text: For the Lord loves judgment and will not abandon His holy ones; they will be guarded for ever. But the lawless will be driven out, and the offspring of the ungodly will be destroyed.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord loves judgment
and will not abandon His holy ones;
they will be guarded for ever.
But the lawless will be driven out,
and the offspring of the ungodly will be destroyed.

verses.text: But the righteous will inherit the land and dwell upon it for age upon age.
verses.display_text:
But the righteous will inherit the land
and dwell upon it for age upon age.

verses.text: The mouth of the righteous will meditate on wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment.
verses.display_text:
The mouth of the righteous will meditate on wisdom,
and his tongue will speak judgment.

verses.text: The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps will not be tripped up.
verses.display_text:
The law of his God is in his heart,
and his steps will not be tripped up.

verses.text: The sinner observes the righteous and seeks to put him to death.
verses.display_text:
The sinner observes the righteous
and seeks to put him to death.

verses.text: But the Lord will certainly not abandon him into his hands, nor condemn him when he comes to judgment with him.
verses.display_text:
But the Lord will certainly not abandon him into his hands,
nor condemn him when he comes to judgment with him.

verses.text: Wait for the Lord and keep His way; He will exalt you to inherit the land; you will see when sinners are destroyed.
I saw an ungodly person raised high and lifting himself like the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.display_text:
I saw an ungodly person raised high
and lifting himself like the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.text: I passed by, and behold, he was gone; I sought him, but his place could not be found.
verses.display_text:
I passed by, and behold, he was gone;
I sought him, but his place could not be found.

verses.text: Guard innocence and look upon uprightness, for a peaceful person has a remnant.
verses.display_text:
Guard innocence and look upon uprightness,
for a peaceful person has a remnant.

verses.text: But the lawless will be destroyed together; the remnants of the ungodly will be destroyed.
verses.display_text:
But the lawless will be destroyed together;
the remnants of the ungodly will be destroyed.

verses.text: But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord, and He is their defender in a time of affliction.
verses.display_text:
But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord,
and He is their defender in a time of affliction.

verses.text: The Lord will help them and rescue them; He will remove them from sinners and save them, because they have hoped in Him.
A psalm of David, for remembrance concerning the Sabbath.
verses.display_text: A psalm of David, for remembrance concerning the Sabbath.

verses.text: Lord, do not rebuke me in Thy fury, nor discipline me in Thine anger.
verses.display_text:
Lord, do not rebuke me in Thy fury,
nor discipline me in Thine anger.

verses.text: For Thine arrows became lodged in me, and Thou didst press Thy hand upon me.
verses.display_text:
For Thine arrows became lodged in me,
and Thou didst press Thy hand upon me.

verses.text: There is no healing in my flesh because of Thine anger; there is no peace for my bones because of my sins.
verses.display_text:
There is no healing in my flesh because of Thine anger;
there is no peace for my bones because of my sins.

verses.text: For my lawless deeds rose above my head; like a heavy load they weighed upon me.
verses.display_text:
For my lawless deeds rose above my head;
like a heavy load they weighed upon me.

verses.text: My bruises stank and rotted because of my foolishness.
verses.display_text:
My bruises stank and rotted
because of my foolishness.

verses.text: I suffered misery and was bent down completely; all day long I walked about downcast.
verses.display_text:
I suffered misery and was bent down completely;
all day long I walked about downcast.

verses.text: For my loins were filled with mockings, and there is no healing in my flesh.
verses.display_text:
For my loins were filled with mockings,
and there is no healing in my flesh.

verses.text: I was afflicted and humbled exceedingly; I roared from the groaning of my heart.
verses.display_text:
I was afflicted and humbled exceedingly;
I roared from the groaning of my heart.

verses.text: Lord, all my desire is before Thee, and my groaning was not hidden from Thee.
verses.display_text:
Lord, all my desire is before Thee,
and my groaning was not hidden from Thee.

verses.text: My heart was troubled; my strength abandoned me; and the light of my eyes—even that is not with me.
verses.display_text:
My heart was troubled; my strength abandoned me;
and the light of my eyes—even that is not with me.

verses.text: My friends and neighbors approached and stood opposite me, and those nearest me stood far away.
verses.display_text:
My friends and neighbors approached and stood opposite me,
and those nearest me stood far away.

verses.text: Those seeking my soul used violence; those seeking evils for me spoke vain things and meditated on deceptions all day long.
But like a deaf person I did not hear, like one unable to speak who does not open his mouth.
verses.display_text:
But like a deaf person I did not hear,
like one unable to speak who does not open his mouth.

verses.text: I became like a person who does not hear and has no rebukes in his mouth.
verses.display_text:
I became like a person who does not hear
and has no rebukes in his mouth.

verses.text: For I hoped in Thee, Lord; Thou wilt hear, Lord my God.
verses.display_text:
For I hoped in Thee, Lord;
Thou wilt hear, Lord my God.

verses.text: For I said, “Let my enemies never rejoice over me!” When my feet were shaken, they boasted against me.
verses.display_text:
For I said, “Let my enemies never rejoice over me!”
When my feet were shaken, they boasted against me.

verses.text: For I am ready for scourges, and my pain is continually before me.
verses.display_text:
For I am ready for scourges,
and my pain is continually before me.

verses.text: For I will announce my lawlessness and be concerned about my sin.
verses.display_text:
For I will announce my lawlessness
and be concerned about my sin.

verses.text: But my enemies live and have become stronger than I, and those hating me unjustly have multiplied.
verses.display_text:
But my enemies live and have become stronger than I,
and those hating me unjustly have multiplied.

verses.text: Those repaying evils for good things slandered me because I pursued righteousness, and they cast me, the beloved, away like an abhorred corpse.
verses.display_text:
Those repaying evils for good things slandered me
because I pursued righteousness,
and they cast me, the beloved, away like an abhorred corpse.

verses.text: Do not abandon me, Lord; my God, do not depart from me.
verses.display_text:
Do not abandon me, Lord;
my God, do not depart from me.

verses.text: Attend to my aid, Lord of my salvation.
verses.display_text:
Attend to my aid,
Lord of my salvation.

verses.text: For the end. For Jeduthun. A song of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. For Jeduthun. A song of David.

verses.text: I said, “I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue.” I placed a guard upon my mouth when the sinner stood against me.
verses.display_text:
I said, “I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue.”
I placed a guard upon my mouth
when the sinner stood against me.

verses.text: I became mute and was humbled and kept silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.
verses.display_text:
I became mute and was humbled and kept silent from good things,
and my pain was renewed.

verses.text: My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation a fire will be kindled. I spoke with my tongue:
verses.display_text:
My heart grew hot within me,
and in my meditation a fire will be kindled.
I spoke with my tongue:

verses.text: “Make known to me, Lord, my limit and the number of my days, what it is, so that I may know what I lack.
verses.display_text:
“Make known to me, Lord, my limit
and the number of my days, what it is,
so that I may know what I lack.

verses.text: Behold, Thou madest my days handbreadths, and my existence is as nothing before Thee. Yet all things are vanity—every living person. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Behold, Thou madest my days handbreadths,
and my existence is as nothing before Thee.
Yet all things are vanity—every living person. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Indeed a person passes through as an image; yet they are troubled in vain. He stores treasure and does not know for whom he will gather it.
And now, what is my expectation? Is it not the Lord? And my existence comes from Thee.
verses.display_text:
And now, what is my expectation? Is it not the Lord?
And my existence comes from Thee.

verses.text: Rescue me from all my lawless deeds; Thou hast given me as a reproach to a fool.
verses.display_text:
Rescue me from all my lawless deeds;
Thou hast given me as a reproach to a fool.

verses.text: I became mute and did not open my mouth, because Thou art the One who made me.
verses.display_text:
I became mute and did not open my mouth,
because Thou art the One who made me.

verses.text: Remove Thy scourges from me; from the strength of Thy hand I wasted away.
verses.display_text:
Remove Thy scourges from me;
from the strength of Thy hand I wasted away.

verses.text: With rebukes for lawlessness Thou didst discipline a person and melt his soul like a spider. Yet every person is troubled in vain. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
With rebukes for lawlessness Thou didst discipline a person
and melt his soul like a spider.
Yet every person is troubled in vain. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my supplication; do not remain silent at my tears. For I am a sojourner with Thee and a temporary resident like all my fathers.
verses.display_text:
Hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my supplication;
do not remain silent at my tears.
For I am a sojourner with Thee
and a temporary resident like all my fathers.

verses.text: Give me relief, that I may be refreshed, before I depart and no longer exist.”
verses.display_text:
Give me relief, that I may be refreshed,
before I depart and no longer exist.”

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David.

verses.text: I waited patiently for the Lord; He attended to me and heard my supplication.
verses.display_text:
I waited patiently for the Lord;
He attended to me and heard my supplication.

verses.text: He brought me up from a pit of misery and from muddy slime; He set my feet upon a rock and directed my steps.
verses.display_text:
He brought me up from a pit of misery
and from muddy slime;
He set my feet upon a rock
and directed my steps.

verses.text: He put a new song into my mouth, a hymn to our God. Many will see and fear and hope in the Lord.
verses.display_text:
He put a new song into my mouth,
a hymn to our God.
Many will see and fear
and hope in the Lord.

verses.text: Blessed is the man whose hope is the Lord’s name and who has not looked toward vanities and false frenzies.
verses.display_text:
Blessed is the man whose hope is the Lord’s name
and who has not looked toward vanities and false frenzies.

verses.text: Many are the wonders Thou hast done, Lord my God, and in Thy purposes there is no one who can be compared with Thee. I announced and spoke; they multiplied beyond number.
verses.display_text:
Many are the wonders Thou hast done, Lord my God,
and in Thy purposes there is no one who can be compared with Thee.
I announced and spoke;
they multiplied beyond number.

verses.text: Sacrifice and offering Thou didst not desire, but ears Thou didst prepare for me. Burnt offering and an offering for sin Thou didst not request.
verses.display_text:
Sacrifice and offering Thou didst not desire,
but ears Thou didst prepare for me.
Burnt offering and an offering for sin Thou didst not request.

verses.text: Then I said, “Behold, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written concerning me.
verses.display_text:
Then I said, “Behold, I have come;
in the scroll of the book it is written concerning me.

verses.text: I desired to do Thy will, my God, and Thy law within my belly.”
verses.display_text:
I desired to do Thy will, my God,
and Thy law within my belly.”

verses.text: I proclaimed good news of righteousness in a great assembly; behold, I will certainly not restrain my lips; Lord, Thou knowest.
I did not hide Thy righteousness in my heart; I spoke of Thy truth and Thy salvation. I did not hide Thy mercy and Thy truth from a great congregation.
But Thou, Lord, do not put Thy compassions far from me; Thy mercy and Thy truth have continually sustained me.
verses.display_text:
But Thou, Lord, do not put Thy compassions far from me;
Thy mercy and Thy truth have continually sustained me.

verses.text: For evils without number surrounded me; my lawless deeds overtook me, and I could not see. They multiplied beyond the hairs of my head, and my heart abandoned me.
verses.display_text:
For evils without number surrounded me;
my lawless deeds overtook me, and I could not see.
They multiplied beyond the hairs of my head,
and my heart abandoned me.

verses.text: Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, attend to helping me.
verses.display_text:
Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me;
Lord, attend to helping me.

verses.text: May those seeking my soul to remove it be ashamed and abashed together; may those desiring evils for me turn backward and be abashed.
verses.display_text:
May those seeking my soul to remove it be ashamed and abashed together;
may those desiring evils for me turn backward and be abashed.

verses.text: Let those saying to me, “Well done! Well done!” receive their shame immediately.
verses.display_text:
Let those saying to me, “Well done! Well done!”
receive their shame immediately.

verses.text: May all seeking Thee exult and rejoice in Thee, Lord; let those loving Thy salvation always say, “May the Lord be magnified!”
But I am poor and needy; the Lord will care for me. Thou art my helper and defender; my God, do not delay.
For the end. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David.

verses.text: Blessed is the one who understands the poor and needy; in an evil day the Lord will rescue him.
verses.display_text:
Blessed is the one who understands the poor and needy;
in an evil day the Lord will rescue him.

verses.text: May the Lord guard him, keep him alive and bless him in the land; may He not hand him over into his enemy’s hands.
verses.display_text:
May the Lord guard him, keep him alive and bless him in the land;
may He not hand him over into his enemy’s hands.

verses.text: May the Lord help him upon his bed of pain; Thou didst turn all his bed in his weakness.
verses.display_text:
May the Lord help him upon his bed of pain;
Thou didst turn all his bed in his weakness.

verses.text: I said, “Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, for I sinned against Thee.”
verses.display_text:
I said, “Lord, have mercy on me;
heal my soul, for I sinned against Thee.”

verses.text: My enemies spoke evils against me: “When will he die and his name perish?”
verses.display_text:
My enemies spoke evils against me:
“When will he die and his name perish?”

verses.text: If someone entered to see me, he spoke vainly; his heart gathered lawlessness for himself; he went outside and spoke.
Together all my enemies whispered against me; against me they devised evils for me.
verses.display_text:
Together all my enemies whispered against me;
against me they devised evils for me.

verses.text: They laid a lawless word against me: “Can it be that the one lying down will not rise again?”
verses.display_text:
They laid a lawless word against me:
“Can it be that the one lying down will not rise again?”

verses.text: For even the man of my peace, in whom I hoped, who ate my loaves, magnified treachery against me.
verses.display_text:
For even the man of my peace, in whom I hoped,
who ate my loaves, magnified treachery against me.

verses.text: But Thou, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.
verses.display_text:
But Thou, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up,
and I will repay them.

verses.text: By this I knew that Thou didst desire me: my enemy will certainly not rejoice over me.
verses.display_text:
By this I knew that Thou didst desire me:
my enemy will certainly not rejoice over me.

verses.text: But Thou didst sustain me because of innocence and establish me before Thee for ever.
verses.display_text:
But Thou didst sustain me because of innocence
and establish me before Thee for ever.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, Israel’s God, from age to age. May it be! May it be!
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord, Israel’s God,
from age to age.
May it be! May it be!

verses.text: For the end. For understanding, of the sons of Korah.
verses.display_text: For the end. For understanding, of the sons of Korah.

verses.text: As the deer longs for springs of water, so my soul longs for Thee, God.
verses.display_text:
As the deer longs for springs of water,
so my soul longs for Thee, God.

verses.text: My soul thirsted for the living God. When will I come and appear before God’s face?
verses.display_text:
My soul thirsted for the living God.
When will I come and appear before God’s face?

verses.text: My tears became my bread day and night, while it is said to me every day, “Where is your God?”
verses.display_text:
My tears became my bread day and night,
while it is said to me every day, “Where is your God?”

verses.text: These things I remembered and poured out my soul within me: for I will pass through the place of a wonderful tent to God’s house, with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving, a celebrating sound.
verses.display_text:
These things I remembered and poured out my soul within me:
for I will pass through the place of a wonderful tent to God’s house,
with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving,
a celebrating sound.

verses.text: Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me? Hope in God, for I will thank Him: my God is the salvation of my face.
verses.display_text:
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me?
Hope in God, for I will thank Him:
my God is the salvation of my face.

verses.text: My soul was troubled within me; therefore I will remember Thee from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from a small mountain.
Deep calls upon deep at the sound of Thy waterfalls; all Thy billows and Thy waves passed over me.
verses.display_text:
Deep calls upon deep at the sound of Thy waterfalls;
all Thy billows and Thy waves passed over me.

verses.text: By day the Lord will command His mercy, and at night a song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.display_text:
By day the Lord will command His mercy,
and at night a song is with me,
a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.text: I will say to God, “Thou art my supporter; why hast Thou forgotten me? Why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?”
verses.display_text:
I will say to God, “Thou art my supporter; why hast Thou forgotten me?
Why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?”

verses.text: As they crushed my bones, those afflicting me reproached me, saying to me every day, “Where is your God?”
verses.display_text:
As they crushed my bones, those afflicting me reproached me,
saying to me every day, “Where is your God?”

verses.text: Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me? Hope in God, for I will thank Him: my God is the salvation of my face.
verses.display_text:
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me?
Hope in God, for I will thank Him:
my God is the salvation of my face.

verses.text: A psalm of David. Judge me, God, and judge my case against an unholy nation; rescue me from an unjust and deceitful person.
For Thou, God, art my strength; why didst Thou thrust me away? And why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?
verses.display_text:
For Thou, God, art my strength; why didst Thou thrust me away?
And why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?

verses.text: Send out Thy light and Thy truth; they guided me and brought me to Thy holy mountain and to Thy dwellings.
Then I will go in to God’s altar, to God who gladdens my youth; I will thank Thee with the lyre, God, my God.
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me? Hope in God, for I will thank Him: my God is the salvation of my face.
verses.display_text:
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me?
Hope in God, for I will thank Him:
my God is the salvation of my face.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah, for understanding.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah, for understanding.

verses.text: God, with our ears we heard; our fathers announced to us the work Thou didst in their days, in ancient days.
Thy hand destroyed nations, and Thou didst plant our fathers; Thou didst afflict peoples and cast them out.
verses.display_text:
Thy hand destroyed nations, and Thou didst plant our fathers;
Thou didst afflict peoples and cast them out.

verses.text: For they did not inherit the land by their sword, and their arm did not save them, but Thy right hand, Thine arm and the light of Thy face, because Thou didst delight in them.
verses.display_text:
For they did not inherit the land by their sword,
and their arm did not save them,
but Thy right hand, Thine arm and the light of Thy face,
because Thou didst delight in them.

verses.text: Thou Thyself art my King and my God, who commands the salvations of Jacob.
verses.display_text:
Thou Thyself art my King and my God,
who commands the salvations of Jacob.

verses.text: Through Thee we will gore our enemies, and through Thy name we will bring to nothing those rising against us.
verses.display_text:
Through Thee we will gore our enemies,
and through Thy name we will bring to nothing those rising against us.

verses.text: For I will not hope in my bow, and my sword will not save me.
verses.display_text:
For I will not hope in my bow,
and my sword will not save me.

verses.text: For Thou didst save us from those afflicting us and put those who hate us to shame.
verses.display_text:
For Thou didst save us from those afflicting us
and put those who hate us to shame.

verses.text: In God we will be praised all day long, and in Thy name we will give thanks for ever. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
In God we will be praised all day long,
and in Thy name we will give thanks for ever. Diapsalma.

verses.text: But now Thou didst thrust us away and put us to shame, and Thou wilt not go out with our forces.
verses.display_text:
But now Thou didst thrust us away and put us to shame,
and Thou wilt not go out with our forces.

verses.text: Thou didst turn us backward before our enemies, and those who hate us plundered for themselves.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst turn us backward before our enemies,
and those who hate us plundered for themselves.

verses.text: Thou gavest us like sheep for eating and didst scatter us among the nations.
verses.display_text:
Thou gavest us like sheep for eating
and didst scatter us among the nations.

verses.text: Thou soldest Thy people without a price, and there was no abundance in their exchange.
verses.display_text:
Thou soldest Thy people without a price,
and there was no abundance in their exchange.

verses.text: Thou madest us a reproach to our neighbors, scorn and ridicule to those around us.
verses.display_text:
Thou madest us a reproach to our neighbors,
scorn and ridicule to those around us.

verses.text: Thou madest us a parable among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.display_text:
Thou madest us a parable among the nations,
a shaking of the head among the peoples.

verses.text: All day long my humiliation is before me, and the shame of my face covered me,
verses.display_text:
All day long my humiliation is before me,
and the shame of my face covered me,

verses.text: at the voice of one reproaching and speaking abusively, at the presence of an enemy and pursuer.
verses.display_text:
at the voice of one reproaching and speaking abusively,
at the presence of an enemy and pursuer.

verses.text: All these things came upon us, and we did not forget Thee or act unjustly in Thy covenant.
verses.display_text:
All these things came upon us, and we did not forget Thee
or act unjustly in Thy covenant.

verses.text: And our heart did not withdraw backward, but Thou didst turn our paths away from Thy way.
verses.display_text:
And our heart did not withdraw backward,
but Thou didst turn our paths away from Thy way.

verses.text: For Thou didst humble us in a place of affliction, and death’s shadow covered us.
verses.display_text:
For Thou didst humble us in a place of affliction,
and death’s shadow covered us.

verses.text: If we forgot our God’s name, and if we spread our hands toward a foreign god,
verses.display_text:
If we forgot our God’s name,
and if we spread our hands toward a foreign god,

verses.text: will God not search these things out? For He knows the heart’s hidden things.
verses.display_text:
will God not search these things out?
For He knows the heart’s hidden things.

verses.text: For Thy sake we are put to death all day long; we were reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
verses.display_text:
For Thy sake we are put to death all day long;
we were reckoned as sheep for slaughter.

verses.text: Awake! Why dost Thou sleep, Lord? Arise, and do not thrust us away completely.
verses.display_text:
Awake! Why dost Thou sleep, Lord?
Arise, and do not thrust us away completely.

verses.text: Why dost Thou turn Thy face away and forget our poverty and affliction?
verses.display_text:
Why dost Thou turn Thy face away
and forget our poverty and affliction?

verses.text: For our soul was humbled to the dust; our belly clung to the earth.
verses.display_text:
For our soul was humbled to the dust;
our belly clung to the earth.

verses.text: Arise, Lord; help us, and redeem us for the sake of Thy name.
verses.display_text:
Arise, Lord; help us,
and redeem us for the sake of Thy name.

verses.text: For the end, concerning those who will be changed. Of the sons of Korah, for understanding. A song concerning the beloved.
verses.display_text:
For the end, concerning those who will be changed.
Of the sons of Korah, for understanding. A song concerning the beloved.

verses.text: My heart poured forth a good word; I speak my works to the king; my tongue is the reed of a swiftly writing scribe.
Fair in beauty beyond the sons of men, grace was poured upon your lips; therefore God blessed you for ever.
Gird your sword upon your thigh, mighty one, in your fairness and your beauty,
verses.display_text:
Gird your sword upon your thigh, mighty one,
in your fairness and your beauty,

verses.text: and stretch forth, prosper and reign for the sake of truth and meekness and righteousness; your right hand will guide you wondrously.
Your arrows are sharpened, mighty one—peoples will fall beneath you— in the heart of the king’s enemies.
verses.display_text:
Your arrows are sharpened, mighty one—peoples will fall beneath you—
in the heart of the king’s enemies.

verses.text: Your throne, God, is for age upon age; a rod of uprightness is the rod of your kingdom.
verses.display_text:
Your throne, God, is for age upon age;
a rod of uprightness is the rod of your kingdom.

verses.text: You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of exultation beyond your companions.
Myrrh, stacte and cassia come from your garments, from ivory palaces, from which they gladdened you.
verses.display_text:
Myrrh, stacte and cassia come from your garments,
from ivory palaces, from which they gladdened you.

verses.text: Daughters of kings are in your honor; the queen stood at your right in clothing woven with gold, arrayed in varied embroidery.
Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear, and forget your people and your father’s house,
verses.display_text:
Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear,
and forget your people and your father’s house,

verses.text: because the king desired your beauty, because he is your lord.
verses.display_text:
because the king desired your beauty,
because he is your lord.

verses.text: And daughters of Tyre will bow down to him with gifts; the rich of the people will entreat your favor.
verses.display_text:
And daughters of Tyre will bow down to him with gifts;
the rich of the people will entreat your favor.

verses.text: All the glory of the king’s daughter is within; she is arrayed in gold-fringed, varied embroidery.
verses.display_text:
All the glory of the king’s daughter is within;
she is arrayed in gold-fringed, varied embroidery.

verses.text: Virgins behind her will be brought to the king; her companions will be brought unto you.
verses.display_text:
Virgins behind her will be brought to the king;
her companions will be brought unto you.

verses.text: They will be brought with gladness and exultation; they will be led into the king’s sanctuary.
verses.display_text:
They will be brought with gladness and exultation;
they will be led into the king’s sanctuary.

verses.text: In place of your fathers, sons were born unto you; you will establish them as rulers over all the earth.
verses.display_text:
In place of your fathers, sons were born unto you;
you will establish them as rulers over all the earth.

verses.text: They will remember your name in every generation; therefore peoples will thank you for ever and for age upon age.
For the end. Concerning the sons of Korah. A psalm concerning hidden things.
verses.display_text: For the end. Concerning the sons of Korah. A psalm concerning hidden things.

verses.text: Our God is refuge and strength, a helper in the afflictions that have greatly overtaken us.
verses.display_text:
Our God is refuge and strength,
a helper in the afflictions that have greatly overtaken us.

verses.text: Therefore we will not fear when the earth is disturbed and mountains are displaced into the hearts of seas.
verses.display_text:
Therefore we will not fear when the earth is disturbed
and mountains are displaced into the hearts of seas.

verses.text: Their waters roared and were disturbed; the mountains were disturbed at his might. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Their waters roared and were disturbed;
the mountains were disturbed at his might. Diapsalma.

verses.text: The river’s rushing streams gladden God’s city; the Most High sanctified His dwelling.
verses.display_text:
The river’s rushing streams gladden God’s city;
the Most High sanctified His dwelling.

verses.text: God is in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her toward morning.
verses.display_text:
God is in her midst; she will not be shaken;
God will help her toward morning.

verses.text: Nations were disturbed; kingdoms bent; He gave His voice; the earth was shaken.
verses.display_text:
Nations were disturbed; kingdoms bent;
He gave His voice; the earth was shaken.

verses.text: The Lord of powers is with us; Jacob’s God is our supporter. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
The Lord of powers is with us;
Jacob’s God is our supporter. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Come, see the Lord’s works, the wonders He has set upon the earth.
verses.display_text:
Come, see the Lord’s works,
the wonders He has set upon the earth.

verses.text: Bringing wars to an end as far as the earth’s limits, He will shatter a bow and break a weapon apart and burn shields in fire.
verses.display_text:
Bringing wars to an end as far as the earth’s limits,
He will shatter a bow and break a weapon apart
and burn shields in fire.

verses.text: “Cease your activity and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, exalted in the earth.”
verses.display_text:
“Cease your activity and know that I am God;
I will be exalted among the nations, exalted in the earth.”

verses.text: The Lord of powers is with us; Jacob’s God is our supporter.
verses.display_text:
The Lord of powers is with us;
Jacob’s God is our supporter.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm concerning the sons of Korah.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm concerning the sons of Korah.

verses.text: All nations, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of exultation.
verses.display_text:
All nations, clap your hands;
shout to God with a voice of exultation.

verses.text: For the Lord Most High is fearsome, a great King over all the earth.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord Most High is fearsome,
a great King over all the earth.

verses.text: He subjected peoples to us and nations beneath our feet.
verses.display_text:
He subjected peoples to us
and nations beneath our feet.

verses.text: He chose His inheritance for us, the beauty of Jacob, which He loved. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
He chose His inheritance for us,
the beauty of Jacob, which He loved. Diapsalma.

verses.text: God ascended with a shout of triumph, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.display_text:
God ascended with a shout of triumph,
the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.text: Make music to our God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
verses.display_text:
Make music to our God, make music;
make music to our King, make music.

verses.text: For God is King of all the earth; make music with understanding.
verses.display_text:
For God is King of all the earth;
make music with understanding.

verses.text: God reigned over the nations; God sits upon His holy throne.
verses.display_text:
God reigned over the nations;
God sits upon His holy throne.

verses.text: The rulers of peoples gathered with Abraham’s God; for the mighty of the earth belong to God; they were greatly exalted.
A psalm of song for the sons of Korah, on the second day of the week.
verses.display_text: A psalm of song for the sons of Korah, on the second day of the week.

verses.text: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in our God’s city, His holy mountain,
verses.display_text:
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised
in our God’s city, His holy mountain,

verses.text: taking good root for the exultation of all the earth. Zion’s mountains, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.display_text:
taking good root for the exultation of all the earth.
Zion’s mountains, the sides of the north,
the city of the great King.

verses.text: God is known in her citadels when He supports her.
verses.display_text: God is known in her citadels when He supports her.

verses.text: For behold, the kings gathered; they came together.
verses.display_text:
For behold, the kings gathered;
they came together.

verses.text: They saw and thus marveled; they were troubled and shaken.
verses.display_text:
They saw and thus marveled;
they were troubled and shaken.

verses.text: Trembling seized them; there were pangs like a woman giving birth.
verses.display_text:
Trembling seized them;
there were pangs like a woman giving birth.

verses.text: With a violent wind Thou wilt shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.display_text: With a violent wind Thou wilt shatter the ships of Tarshish.

verses.text: Just as we heard, so we saw in the city of the Lord of powers, in our God’s city; God founded her for ever. Diapsalma.
We received Thy mercy, God, in the midst of Thy sanctuary.
verses.display_text:
We received Thy mercy, God,
in the midst of Thy sanctuary.

verses.text: According to Thy name, God, so also Thy praise reaches the earth’s limits; Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice; let Judea’s daughters exult because of Thy judgments, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Let Mount Zion rejoice;
let Judea’s daughters exult because of Thy judgments, Lord.

verses.text: Encircle Zion and encompass her; recount in her towers,
verses.display_text:
Encircle Zion and encompass her;
recount in her towers,

verses.text: set your hearts upon her strength and divide her citadels, so that you may tell another generation.
verses.display_text:
set your hearts upon her strength
and divide her citadels,
so that you may tell another generation.

verses.text: For this is God, our God for ever and for age upon age; He will shepherd us through the ages.
For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah.

verses.text: Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all who inhabit the world,
verses.display_text:
Hear these things, all nations;
give ear, all who inhabit the world,

verses.text: both the earthborn and the sons of men, rich and poor together.
verses.display_text:
both the earthborn and the sons of men,
rich and poor together.

verses.text: My mouth will speak wisdom, and my heart’s meditation understanding.
verses.display_text:
My mouth will speak wisdom,
and my heart’s meditation understanding.

verses.text: I will incline my ear to a parable; with a psaltery I will open my riddle.
verses.display_text:
I will incline my ear to a parable;
with a psaltery I will open my riddle.

verses.text: Why do I fear in an evil day? The lawlessness of my heel will surround me.
verses.display_text:
Why do I fear in an evil day?
The lawlessness of my heel will surround me.

verses.text: Those trusting in their strength and boasting in the abundance of their wealth,
verses.display_text:
Those trusting in their strength
and boasting in the abundance of their wealth,

verses.text: A brother does not redeem; will a person redeem? He will not give God his atonement price
verses.display_text:
A brother does not redeem; will a person redeem?
He will not give God his atonement price

verses.text: and the price of the redemption of his soul.
verses.display_text: and the price of the redemption of his soul.

verses.text: And he ceased for ever and will live to the end, for he will not see corruption when he sees wise people dying.
verses.display_text:
And he ceased for ever and will live to the end,
for he will not see corruption when he sees wise people dying.

verses.text: The foolish and senseless will perish together and leave their wealth to strangers.
verses.display_text:
The foolish and senseless will perish together
and leave their wealth to strangers.

verses.text: Their tombs are their houses for ever, their dwellings from generation to generation; they invoked their names upon their lands.
A person, though in honor, did not understand; he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.
verses.display_text:
A person, though in honor, did not understand;
he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.

verses.text: This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them, and afterward they will take delight with their mouth. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them,
and afterward they will take delight with their mouth. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Like sheep they were placed in Hades; death shepherds them. The upright will rule over them in the morning, and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.
verses.display_text:
Like sheep they were placed in Hades; death shepherds them.
The upright will rule over them in the morning,
and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.

verses.text: But God will redeem my soul from Hades’ hand when He receives me. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
But God will redeem my soul from Hades’ hand
when He receives me. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Do not fear when a person grows rich and when the glory of his house increases.
verses.display_text:
Do not fear when a person grows rich
and when the glory of his house increases.

verses.text: For when he dies he will not take everything, nor will his glory descend with him.
verses.display_text:
For when he dies he will not take everything,
nor will his glory descend with him.

verses.text: For his soul will be blessed during his lifetime; he will thank you when you do good to him.
verses.display_text:
For his soul will be blessed during his lifetime;
he will thank you when you do good to him.

verses.text: He will enter as far as the generation of his fathers; he will never see light.
verses.display_text:
He will enter as far as the generation of his fathers;
he will never see light.

verses.text: A person, though in honor, did not understand; he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.
verses.display_text:
A person, though in honor, did not understand;
he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.

verses.text: A psalm of Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and summoned the earth from the sun’s risings to its settings.
verses.display_text:
A psalm of Asaph.
The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and summoned the earth
from the sun’s risings to its settings.

verses.text: From Zion comes the splendor of His beauty; God will come manifestly,
verses.display_text:
From Zion comes the splendor of His beauty;
God will come manifestly,

verses.text: our God, and He will not keep silent; fire will burn before Him, and around Him is a mighty tempest.
He will summon heaven above and the earth, to judge His people.
verses.display_text:
He will summon heaven above
and the earth, to judge His people.

verses.text: Gather His holy ones to Him, those who establish His covenant over sacrifices.
verses.display_text:
Gather His holy ones to Him,
those who establish His covenant over sacrifices.

verses.text: The heavens will announce His righteousness, for God is judge. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
The heavens will announce His righteousness,
for God is judge. Diapsalma.

verses.text: “Hear, My people, and I will speak unto you; Israel, I testify unto you. I am God, your God.
I will not rebuke you concerning your sacrifices; your burnt offerings are continually before Me.
verses.display_text:
I will not rebuke you concerning your sacrifices;
your burnt offerings are continually before Me.

verses.text: I will not receive calves from your house or young goats from your flocks.
verses.display_text:
I will not receive calves from your house
or young goats from your flocks.

verses.text: For all the forest’s wild animals are Mine, beasts on the mountains and cattle.
verses.display_text:
For all the forest’s wild animals are Mine,
beasts on the mountains and cattle.

verses.text: I know all the birds of heaven, and the field’s beauty is with Me.
verses.display_text:
I know all the birds of heaven,
and the field’s beauty is with Me.

verses.text: If I become hungry, I will certainly not tell you, for the inhabited world and its fullness are Mine.
verses.display_text:
If I become hungry, I will certainly not tell you,
for the inhabited world and its fullness are Mine.

verses.text: Will I eat bulls’ flesh or drink goats’ blood?
verses.display_text:
Will I eat bulls’ flesh
or drink goats’ blood?

verses.text: Sacrifice a sacrifice of praise to God and pay your vows to the Most High.
verses.display_text:
Sacrifice a sacrifice of praise to God
and pay your vows to the Most High.

verses.text: Call on Me in the day of affliction; I will rescue you, and you will glorify Me.” Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Call on Me in the day of affliction;
I will rescue you, and you will glorify Me.” Diapsalma.

verses.text: But to the sinner God said, “Why do you recount My decrees and take up My covenant through your mouth?
verses.display_text:
But to the sinner God said,
“Why do you recount My decrees
and take up My covenant through your mouth?

verses.text: But you hated instruction and cast My words behind you.
verses.display_text:
But you hated instruction
and cast My words behind you.

verses.text: If you saw a thief, you would run along with him, and you would place your portion with adulterers.
verses.display_text:
If you saw a thief, you would run along with him,
and you would place your portion with adulterers.

verses.text: Your mouth multiplied wickedness, and your tongue was weaving deception.
verses.display_text:
Your mouth multiplied wickedness,
and your tongue was weaving deception.

verses.text: Sitting, you would speak against your brother, and against your mother’s son you would place a stumbling block.
verses.display_text:
Sitting, you would speak against your brother,
and against your mother’s son you would place a stumbling block.

verses.text: These things you did, and I kept silent; you conceived the lawless thought that I would be like you. I will rebuke you and set it before your face.
Understand these things, you who forget God, lest He seize you and there be no rescuer.
verses.display_text:
Understand these things, you who forget God,
lest He seize you and there be no rescuer.

verses.text: A sacrifice of praise will glorify Me, and there is a way by which I will show him God’s salvation.”
verses.display_text:
A sacrifice of praise will glorify Me,
and there is a way by which I will show him God’s salvation.”

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of David,
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of David,

verses.text: when Nathan the prophet came to him, when he had gone in to Bathsheba.
verses.display_text:
when Nathan the prophet came to him,
when he had gone in to Bathsheba.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, God, according to Thy great mercy, and according to the abundance of Thy compassions blot out my lawless deed.
verses.display_text:
Have mercy on me, God, according to Thy great mercy,
and according to the abundance of Thy compassions blot out my lawless deed.

verses.text: Wash me more and more from my lawlessness, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.display_text:
Wash me more and more from my lawlessness,
and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.text: For I know my lawlessness, and my sin is continually before me.
verses.display_text:
For I know my lawlessness,
and my sin is continually before me.

verses.text: Against Thee alone I sinned and did evil before Thee, so that Thou mayest be justified in Thy words and prevail when Thou art judged.
verses.display_text:
Against Thee alone I sinned
and did evil before Thee,
so that Thou mayest be justified in Thy words
and prevail when Thou art judged.

verses.text: For behold, I was conceived in lawless deeds, and in sins my mother conceived me.
verses.display_text:
For behold, I was conceived in lawless deeds,
and in sins my mother conceived me.

verses.text: For behold, Thou didst love truth; Thou madest known to me the unseen and hidden things of Thy wisdom.
verses.display_text:
