For behold, Thou didst love truth;
Thou madest known to me the unseen and hidden things of Thy wisdom.

verses.display_text:
Thou wilt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed;
Thou wilt wash me, and I will be whitened beyond snow.

verses.text: Thou wilt make me hear exultation and gladness; humbled bones will exult.
verses.display_text:
Thou wilt make me hear exultation and gladness;
humbled bones will exult.

verses.text: Turn Thy face away from my sins, and blot out all my lawless deeds.
verses.display_text:
Turn Thy face away from my sins,
and blot out all my lawless deeds.

verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew an upright spirit in my inward parts.
verses.display_text:
Create in me a clean heart, O God,
and renew an upright spirit in my inward parts.

verses.text: Do not cast me away from Thy face, and do not remove Thy holy Spirit from me.
verses.display_text:
Do not cast me away from Thy face,
and do not remove Thy holy Spirit from me.

verses.text: Restore to me the exultation of Thy salvation, and strengthen me with a governing spirit.
verses.display_text:
Restore to me the exultation of Thy salvation,
and strengthen me with a governing spirit.

verses.text: I will teach the lawless Thy ways, and the ungodly will turn back unto Thee.
verses.display_text:
I will teach the lawless Thy ways,
and the ungodly will turn back unto Thee.

verses.text: Rescue me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation; my tongue will exult in Thy righteousness.
verses.display_text:
Rescue me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation;
my tongue will exult in Thy righteousness.

verses.text: Lord, Thou wilt open my lips, and my mouth will announce Thy praise.
verses.display_text:
Lord, Thou wilt open my lips,
and my mouth will announce Thy praise.

verses.display_text:
For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would have given it;

verses.display_text:
A sacrifice to God is a broken spirit;

verses.text: Do good to Zion, Lord, in Thy good pleasure, and let Jerusalem’s walls be built.
verses.display_text:
Do good to Zion, Lord, in Thy good pleasure,

verses.text: Then Thou wilt delight in a sacrifice of righteousness, an offering and burnt offerings; then they will bring calves upon Thine altar.

verses.text: when Doeg the Idumean came and reported to Saul, and said to him, “David came to Abimelech’s house.”

when Doeg the Idumean came and reported to Saul,

verses.display_text:
Why do you boast in wickedness, mighty one,
in lawlessness all day long?

verses.display_text:
Your tongue devised injustice;
like a sharpened razor you worked deceit.

verses.text: You loved wickedness more than goodness, injustice more than speaking righteousness. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
You loved wickedness more than goodness,

verses.display_text:

verses.text: Therefore God will pull you down completely; may He pluck you out and remove you from your dwelling, and your root from the land of the living. Diapsalma.

The righteous will see and fear;

verses.text: “Look at the person who did not make God his helper, but hoped in the abundance of his wealth and became strong in his vanity.”
verses.display_text:

verses.text: But I am like a fruitful olive tree in God’s house; I hoped in God’s mercy for ever and for age upon age.

verses.display_text:
I will thank Thee for ever, because Thou didst act,

because it is kind before Thy holy ones.

verses.display_text: For the end. Concerning Maeleth. Of understanding, of David.

verses.text: A fool said in his heart, “There is no God.” They became corrupt and abominable in lawless deeds; there is no one doing good.

verses.display_text:
God bent down from heaven toward the sons of men,
to see whether anyone understands or seeks God.

verses.text: All turned aside; together they became useless; there is no one doing good, not a single one.
verses.display_text:
All turned aside; together they became useless;
there is no one doing good, not a single one.

verses.text: Will all who work lawlessness not learn? Those eating my people like the eating of bread did not call on God.
verses.display_text:
Will all who work lawlessness not learn?
Those eating my people like the eating of bread did not call on God.

verses.text: There they will fear greatly where there was no fear, for God scattered the bones of people-pleasers. They were put to shame, for God despised them.
verses.display_text:
There they will fear greatly where there was no fear,
for God scattered the bones of people-pleasers.

verses.display_text:
Who will give Israel’s salvation from Zion?

verses.text: For the end. Among hymns. Of understanding, of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. Among hymns. Of understanding, of David.

verses.text: When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Behold, is David not hidden among us?”
verses.display_text: When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Behold, is David not hidden among us?”

verses.text: God, save me by Thy name, and judge me by Thy power.
verses.display_text:
God, save me by Thy name,
and judge me by Thy power.

verses.text: God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.display_text:
God, hear my prayer;
give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.text: For outsiders rose against me, and powerful men sought my soul; they did not set God before themselves. Diapsalma.
For behold, God helps me, and the Lord is the supporter of my soul.
verses.display_text:
For behold, God helps me,
and the Lord is the supporter of my soul.

verses.text: He will turn the evils back upon my enemies; in Thy truth, utterly destroy them.
verses.display_text:
He will turn the evils back upon my enemies;
in Thy truth, utterly destroy them.

verses.text: I will sacrifice unto Thee willingly; I will give thanks to Thy name, Lord, for it is good.
verses.display_text:
I will sacrifice unto Thee willingly;
I will give thanks to Thy name, Lord, for it is good.

verses.text: For Thou didst rescue me from every affliction, and my eye has looked upon my enemies.
verses.display_text:
For Thou didst rescue me from every affliction,
and my eye has looked upon my enemies.

verses.text: For the end. Among hymns. Of understanding, of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. Among hymns. Of understanding, of David.

verses.text: Give ear, God, to my prayer, and do not overlook my petition.
verses.display_text:
Give ear, God, to my prayer,
and do not overlook my petition.

verses.text: Attend to me and hear me. I was grieved in my meditation and troubled
verses.display_text:
Attend to me and hear me.
I was grieved in my meditation and troubled

verses.text: by an enemy’s voice and a sinner’s affliction, for they turned lawlessness upon me and harbored anger against me.
verses.display_text:
by an enemy’s voice and a sinner’s affliction,
for they turned lawlessness upon me
and harbored anger against me.

verses.text: My heart was troubled within me, and dread of death fell upon me.
verses.display_text:
My heart was troubled within me,
and dread of death fell upon me.

verses.text: Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.
verses.display_text:
Fear and trembling came upon me,
and darkness covered me.

verses.text: I said, “Who will give me wings like a dove’s, so that I may fly away and rest?”
verses.display_text:
I said, “Who will give me wings like a dove’s,
so that I may fly away and rest?”

verses.text: Behold, I went far away in flight and lodged in the wilderness. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Behold, I went far away in flight
and lodged in the wilderness. Diapsalma.

verses.text: I waited for the one saving me from faintheartedness and tempest.
verses.display_text:
I waited for the one saving me
from faintheartedness and tempest.

verses.text: Drown them, Lord, and divide their tongues, for I saw lawlessness and contradiction in the city.
verses.display_text:
Drown them, Lord, and divide their tongues,
for I saw lawlessness and contradiction in the city.

verses.text: Day and night it will circle it upon its walls; lawlessness and toil are within it, and injustice,
verses.display_text:
Day and night it will circle it upon its walls;
lawlessness and toil are within it, and injustice,

verses.text: and interest-taking and deceit did not depart from its squares.
verses.display_text: and interest-taking and deceit did not depart from its squares.

verses.text: For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have endured it; and if the one hating me had boasted against me, I would have hidden from him.
verses.display_text:
For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have endured it;
and if the one hating me had boasted against me, I would have hidden from him.

verses.text: But you, a man of like soul, my leader and my acquaintance,
verses.display_text:
But you, a man of like soul,
my leader and my acquaintance,

verses.text: you who made food sweet together with me: in God’s house we walked in concord.
verses.display_text:
you who made food sweet together with me:
in God’s house we walked in concord.

verses.text: Let death come upon them, and let them descend alive into Hades, for wicked things are in their sojournings, within them.
verses.display_text:
Let death come upon them,
and let them descend alive into Hades,
for wicked things are in their sojournings, within them.

verses.text: But I cried to God, and the Lord heard me.
verses.display_text:
But I cried to God,
and the Lord heard me.

verses.text: Evening, morning and noon I will recount; I will proclaim, and He will hear my voice.
verses.display_text:
Evening, morning and noon I will recount;
I will proclaim, and He will hear my voice.

verses.text: He will redeem my soul in peace from those drawing near me, for among many they were with me.
verses.display_text:
He will redeem my soul in peace from those drawing near me,
for among many they were with me.

verses.text: God will hear and humble them, He who exists before the ages. Diapsalma. For they have no exchange, and they did not fear God.
verses.display_text:
God will hear and humble them,
He who exists before the ages. Diapsalma.
For they have no exchange,
and they did not fear God.

verses.text: He stretched out his hand in making repayment; they profaned his covenant.
verses.display_text:
He stretched out his hand in making repayment;
they profaned his covenant.

verses.text: They were divided by the anger of his face, and his heart drew near; his words became softer than oil, yet they are missiles.
verses.display_text:
They were divided by the anger of his face,
and his heart drew near;
his words became softer than oil,
yet they are missiles.

verses.text: Cast your care upon the Lord, and He will nourish you; He will never give the righteous a shaking.
verses.display_text:
Cast your care upon the Lord, and He will nourish you;
He will never give the righteous a shaking.

verses.text: But Thou, God, wilt bring them down into a well of corruption; men of bloodshed and deceit shall certainly not live out half their days. But I will hope in Thee, Lord.
For the end. Concerning the people far removed from the holy ones. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar, when the foreigners seized him in Gath.
verses.display_text: For the end. Concerning the people far removed from the holy ones. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar, when the foreigners seized him in Gath.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, Lord, for a man trampled me; fighting all day, he afflicted me.
verses.display_text:
Have mercy on me, Lord, for a man trampled me;
fighting all day, he afflicted me.

verses.text: My enemies trampled me all day, for many are those fighting me from a height.
verses.display_text:
My enemies trampled me all day,
for many are those fighting me from a height.

verses.text: By day I will fear, but I will hope in Thee.
verses.display_text:
By day I will fear,
but I will hope in Thee.

verses.text: In God I will praise my words all day. In God I have hoped; I will not fear. What will flesh do to me?
verses.display_text:
In God I will praise my words all day.
In God I have hoped; I will not fear.
What will flesh do to me?

verses.text: All day they detested my words; all their thoughts against me are for evil.
verses.display_text:
All day they detested my words;
all their thoughts against me are for evil.

verses.text: They will sojourn and conceal themselves; they will watch my heel, just as they waited for my soul.
For nothing Thou wilt save them; in anger Thou wilt bring down peoples, God.
verses.display_text:
For nothing Thou wilt save them;
in anger Thou wilt bring down peoples, God.

verses.text: I declared my life unto Thee; Thou didst set my tears before Thee, as also in Thy promise.
verses.display_text:
I declared my life unto Thee;
Thou didst set my tears before Thee, as also in Thy promise.

verses.text: My enemies will turn backward on whatever day I call upon Thee. Behold, I know that Thou art my God.
verses.display_text:
My enemies will turn backward on whatever day I call upon Thee.
Behold, I know that Thou art my God.

verses.text: In God I will praise an utterance; in the Lord I will praise a word.
verses.display_text:
In God I will praise an utterance;
in the Lord I will praise a word.

verses.text: In God I have hoped; I will not fear. What will a human being do to me?
verses.display_text:
In God I have hoped; I will not fear.
What will a human being do to me?

verses.text: Within me, God, are the vows of praise that I will pay unto Thee,
verses.display_text: Within me, God, are the vows of praise that I will pay unto Thee,

verses.text: because Thou didst rescue my soul from death and my feet from slipping, that I may be pleasing before God in the light of the living.
verses.display_text:
because Thou didst rescue my soul from death
and my feet from slipping,
that I may be pleasing before God in the light of the living.

verses.text: For the end. Do not destroy. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar, when he escaped from Saul’s presence into the cave.
verses.display_text: For the end. Do not destroy. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar, when he escaped from Saul’s presence into the cave.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, God, have mercy on me, for my soul has trusted in Thee; in the shadow of Thy wings I will hope until lawlessness passes.
verses.display_text:
Have mercy on me, God, have mercy on me,
for my soul has trusted in Thee;
in the shadow of Thy wings I will hope
until lawlessness passes.

verses.text: I will cry to God Most High, to God who has done good to me.
verses.display_text:
I will cry to God Most High,
to God who has done good to me.

verses.text: He sent from heaven and saved me; He gave those trampling me over to reproach. Diapsalma. God sent His mercy and His truth
and rescued my soul from among young lions. I lay down troubled. Sons of men—their teeth are a weapon and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.display_text:
and rescued my soul from among young lions.
I lay down troubled.
Sons of men—their teeth are a weapon and arrows,
and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.text: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and Thy glory above all the earth.
verses.display_text:
Be exalted above the heavens, God,
and Thy glory above all the earth.

verses.text: They prepared a trap for my feet and bowed my soul down; they dug a pit before me and fell into it. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
They prepared a trap for my feet
and bowed my soul down;
they dug a pit before me
and fell into it. Diapsalma.

verses.text: My heart is ready, God; my heart is ready. I will sing and make music.
verses.display_text:
My heart is ready, God; my heart is ready.
I will sing and make music.

verses.text: Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and lyre! I will awake at dawn.
verses.display_text:
Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and lyre!
I will awake at dawn.

verses.text: I will give thanks unto Thee among peoples, Lord; I will make music unto Thee among nations,
verses.display_text:
I will give thanks unto Thee among peoples, Lord;
I will make music unto Thee among nations,

verses.text: for Thy mercy was magnified to the heavens, and Thy truth to the clouds.
verses.display_text:
for Thy mercy was magnified to the heavens,
and Thy truth to the clouds.

verses.text: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and Thy glory above all the earth.
verses.display_text:
Be exalted above the heavens, God,
and Thy glory above all the earth.

verses.text: For the end. Do not destroy. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar.
verses.display_text: For the end. Do not destroy. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar.

verses.text: Do you then truly speak righteousness? Do you judge uprightly, sons of men?
verses.display_text:
Do you then truly speak righteousness?
Do you judge uprightly, sons of men?

verses.text: For indeed in your heart you work lawless deeds on earth; your hands weave injustice together.
verses.display_text:
For indeed in your heart you work lawless deeds on earth;
your hands weave injustice together.

verses.text: Sinners were estranged from the womb; from the belly they went astray and spoke lies.
verses.display_text:
Sinners were estranged from the womb;
from the belly they went astray and spoke lies.

verses.text: Their fury is in the likeness of a serpent, like that of a deaf asp that stops up its ears,
verses.display_text:
Their fury is in the likeness of a serpent,
like that of a deaf asp that stops up its ears,

verses.text: which will not hear the voice of enchanters, or a spell being cast by a wise person.
verses.display_text:
which will not hear the voice of enchanters,
or a spell being cast by a wise person.

verses.text: God shattered their teeth in their mouth; the Lord crushed the lions’ grinders.
verses.display_text:
God shattered their teeth in their mouth;
the Lord crushed the lions’ grinders.

verses.text: They will be reduced to nothing like water passing away; He will stretch His bow until they grow weak.
verses.display_text:
They will be reduced to nothing like water passing away;
He will stretch His bow until they grow weak.

verses.text: Like wax that melted, they will be taken away; fire fell, and they did not see the sun.
verses.display_text:
Like wax that melted, they will be taken away;
fire fell, and they did not see the sun.

verses.text: Before your thorns understand the buckthorn, as though alive, as in anger, He will swallow you.
verses.display_text:
Before your thorns understand the buckthorn,
as though alive, as in anger, He will swallow you.

verses.text: A righteous person will rejoice when he sees vengeance upon the ungodly; he will wash his hands in the sinner’s blood.
verses.display_text:
A righteous person will rejoice when he sees vengeance upon the ungodly;
he will wash his hands in the sinner’s blood.

verses.text: A human being will say, “Then there is indeed fruit for the righteous; then there is God judging them on earth.”
verses.display_text:
A human being will say, “Then there is indeed fruit for the righteous;
then there is God judging them on earth.”

verses.text: For the end. Do not destroy. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar, when Saul sent and watched his house to put him to death.
verses.display_text: For the end. Do not destroy. Of David, for an inscription on a pillar, when Saul sent and watched his house to put him to death.

verses.text: Take me out from my enemies, God, and redeem me from those rising against me.
verses.display_text:
Take me out from my enemies, God,
and redeem me from those rising against me.

verses.text: Deliver me from those working lawlessness, and save me from men of bloodshed.
verses.display_text:
Deliver me from those working lawlessness,
and save me from men of bloodshed.

verses.text: For behold, they hunted my soul; powerful men attacked me. Neither my lawlessness nor my sin, Lord—
without lawlessness they ran and made straight. Awake to meet me, and see!
verses.display_text:
without lawlessness they ran and made straight.
Awake to meet me, and see!

verses.text: And Thou, Lord, God of powers, God of Israel, attend to visiting all the nations; have no compassion on any who work lawlessness. Diapsalma.
They will return toward evening, hunger like a dog, and circle a city.
verses.display_text:
They will return toward evening, hunger like a dog,
and circle a city.

verses.text: Behold, they will speak out with their mouths, and a sword is on their lips; for who has heard?
And Thou, Lord, wilt laugh them to scorn; Thou wilt reduce all nations to nothing.
verses.display_text:
And Thou, Lord, wilt laugh them to scorn;
Thou wilt reduce all nations to nothing.

verses.text: My strength—I will keep watch toward Thee, for Thou, God, art my supporter.
verses.display_text:
My strength—I will keep watch toward Thee,
for Thou, God, art my supporter.

verses.text: My God’s mercy will reach me first; God will show me what concerns my enemies.
verses.display_text:
My God’s mercy will reach me first;
God will show me what concerns my enemies.

verses.text: Do not kill them, lest they forget my people; scatter them by Thy power and bring them down, Lord, my defender.
The sin of their mouth, the word of their lips— let them be caught in their arrogance; and from curse and falsehood consummations will be announced
in the anger of consummation, and they shall certainly not exist; and they will know that God rules Jacob and the ends of the earth. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
in the anger of consummation, and they shall certainly not exist;
and they will know that God rules Jacob and the ends of the earth. Diapsalma.

verses.text: They will return toward evening, hunger like a dog, and circle a city.
verses.display_text:
They will return toward evening, hunger like a dog,
and circle a city.

verses.text: They will be scattered in search of food; and if they are not filled, they will grumble.
verses.display_text:
They will be scattered in search of food;
and if they are not filled, they will grumble.

verses.text: But I will sing to Thy power and exult in Thy mercy in the morning, for Thou becamest my supporter and a refuge in the day of my affliction.
verses.display_text:
But I will sing to Thy power
and exult in Thy mercy in the morning,
for Thou becamest my supporter
and a refuge in the day of my affliction.

verses.text: My helper, I will make music unto Thee, for Thou, God, art my supporter, my God, my mercy.
For the end. For those who will yet be changed. For an inscription on a pillar, of David, for instruction.
verses.display_text: For the end. For those who will yet be changed. For an inscription on a pillar, of David, for instruction.

verses.text: When he burned Mesopotamia of Syria and Syria Zobah, and Joab returned and struck the Valley of Salt—twelve thousand.
verses.display_text: When he burned Mesopotamia of Syria and Syria Zobah, and Joab returned and struck the Valley of Salt—twelve thousand.

verses.text: God, Thou didst reject us and pull us down; Thou wast angry and hadst compassion on us.
verses.display_text:
God, Thou didst reject us and pull us down;
Thou wast angry and hadst compassion on us.

verses.text: Thou didst shake the earth and trouble it; heal its fractures, for it was shaken.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst shake the earth and trouble it;
heal its fractures, for it was shaken.

verses.text: Thou didst show Thy people hard things; Thou madest us drink wine of stupor.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst show Thy people hard things;
Thou madest us drink wine of stupor.

verses.text: Thou gavest those who fear Thee a sign to flee from the face of a bow. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Thou gavest those who fear Thee a sign
to flee from the face of a bow. Diapsalma.

verses.text: So that Thy beloved may be rescued, save by Thy right hand and hear me.
verses.display_text:
So that Thy beloved may be rescued,
save by Thy right hand and hear me.

verses.text: God spoke in His holy place: “I will exult and divide Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Tents.
verses.display_text:
God spoke in His holy place:
“I will exult and divide Shechem,
and measure out the Valley of Tents.

verses.text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is the strengthening of My head; Judah is My king.
Moab is the basin of My hope; upon Idumea I will extend My sandal; foreigners were subjected to Me.”
Who will lead me away into an enclosed city? Who will guide me as far as Idumea?
verses.display_text:
Who will lead me away into an enclosed city?
Who will guide me as far as Idumea?

verses.text: Is it not Thou, God, who didst reject us? And Thou wilt not go out, God, with our forces.
verses.display_text:
Is it not Thou, God, who didst reject us?
And Thou wilt not go out, God, with our forces.

verses.text: Give us help from affliction, for human salvation is vain.
verses.display_text:
Give us help from affliction,
for human salvation is vain.

verses.text: But through God we will do a mighty deed, and He will reduce our afflicters to nothing.
verses.display_text:
But through God we will do a mighty deed,
and He will reduce our afflicters to nothing.

verses.text: For the end. Among hymns. Of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. Among hymns. Of David.

verses.text: Hear my petition, God; attend to my prayer.
verses.display_text:
Hear my petition, God;
attend to my prayer.

verses.display_text:
From the ends of the earth I cried unto Thee when my heart grew weary;
Thou didst raise me upon a rock,

verses.display_text:
Thou didst guide me, for Thou becamest my hope,
a tower of strength before the enemy.

verses.text: I will sojourn in Thy dwelling for the ages; I will be sheltered under the shelter of Thy wings. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
I will sojourn in Thy dwelling for the ages;
I will be sheltered under the shelter of Thy wings. Diapsalma.

verses.text: For Thou, God, heardest my vows; Thou gavest an inheritance to those who fear Thy name.
verses.display_text:
For Thou, God, heardest my vows;
Thou gavest an inheritance to those who fear Thy name.

verses.text: Thou wilt add days upon the king’s days, his years until the day of generation upon generation.
verses.display_text:
Thou wilt add days upon the king’s days,
his years until the day of generation upon generation.

verses.text: He will remain for ever before God; who will seek out his mercy and truth?
verses.display_text:
He will remain for ever before God;
who will seek out his mercy and truth?

verses.text: So I will make music to Thy name for the age of the age, that I may pay my vows day by day.
verses.display_text:
So I will make music to Thy name for the age of the age,
that I may pay my vows day by day.

verses.text: For the end. Concerning Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
verses.display_text: For the end. Concerning Jeduthun. A psalm of David.

verses.text: Will my soul not submit to God? For from Him is my salvation.
verses.display_text:
Will my soul not submit to God?
For from Him is my salvation.

verses.text: For He is my God and my Savior, my supporter; I shall certainly not be shaken any further.
verses.display_text:
For He is my God and my Savior,
my supporter; I shall certainly not be shaken any further.

verses.text: How long do you attack a human being? All of you murder, as against a leaning wall and a fence thrust down.
verses.display_text:
How long do you attack a human being?
All of you murder,
as against a leaning wall and a fence thrust down.

verses.text: Nevertheless they planned to reject my honor; they ran in falsehood; they blessed with their mouths but cursed with their hearts. Diapsalma.
Nevertheless submit to God, my soul, for my endurance is from Him.
verses.display_text:
Nevertheless submit to God, my soul,
for my endurance is from Him.

verses.text: For He is my God and my Savior, my supporter; I shall certainly not migrate away.
verses.display_text:
For He is my God and my Savior,
my supporter; I shall certainly not migrate away.

verses.text: Upon God rest my salvation and my glory; the God of my help—and my hope is upon God.
verses.display_text:
Upon God rest my salvation and my glory;
the God of my help—and my hope is upon God.

verses.text: Hope in Him, all the assembly of the people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our helper. Diapsalma.
Nevertheless the sons of men are vain; the sons of men are false upon scales for doing injustice, they themselves together from vanity.
Do not hope in injustice or long for plunder; if wealth flows, do not attach your heart.
verses.display_text:
Do not hope in injustice or long for plunder;
if wealth flows, do not attach your heart.

verses.text: God spoke once; these two things I heard:

verses.text: that power belongs to God, and mercy unto Thee, Lord, for Thou wilt repay each one according to his works.
verses.display_text:
that power belongs to God, and mercy unto Thee, Lord,
for Thou wilt repay each one according to his works.

verses.display_text: A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judea.

verses.text: God, my God, toward Thee I rise at dawn; my soul thirsted for Thee. How greatly my flesh longs for Thee in a desert, trackless and waterless land!
verses.display_text:
God, my God, toward Thee I rise at dawn;
my soul thirsted for Thee.
How greatly my flesh longs for Thee
in a desert, trackless and waterless land!

verses.display_text:
So I was seen by Thee in the holy place,
to see Thy power and Thy glory.

verses.text: For Thy mercy is better than lives; my lips will praise Thee.
verses.display_text:
For Thy mercy is better than lives;
my lips will praise Thee.

verses.text: So I will bless Thee in my life; in Thy name I will lift my hands.
verses.display_text:
So I will bless Thee in my life;
in Thy name I will lift my hands.

verses.text: May my soul be filled as with fat and richness, and my mouth will praise with lips of exultation.
verses.display_text:
May my soul be filled as with fat and richness,
and my mouth will praise with lips of exultation.

verses.display_text:
If I remembered Thee upon my bed,
in the dawn hours I meditated upon Thee.

verses.display_text:
For Thou becamest my helper,
and in the shelter of Thy wings I will exult.

verses.text: My soul clung behind Thee; Thy right hand supported me.
verses.display_text:
My soul clung behind Thee;
Thy right hand supported me.

verses.display_text:

they will enter the lowest places of the earth.

the God of gods will appear in Zion.

verses.text: Lord, God of powers, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Diapsalma.
Look, God our defender; look upon the face of Thine anointed.
verses.display_text:
Look, God our defender;
look upon the face of Thine anointed.

verses.text: For one day in Thy courts is better than thousands; I chose to be cast aside in the house of God rather than dwell in the tents of sinners.
For the Lord God loves mercy and truth; He will give grace and glory; the Lord will not deprive those who walk in innocence of good things.
Lord of powers, blessed is the person who hopes in Thee.
verses.display_text:
Lord of powers,
blessed is the person who hopes in Thee.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.display_text:
For the end.
A psalm for the sons of Korah.

verses.text: Thou tookest pleasure in Thy land, Lord; Thou didst turn back Jacob’s captivity.
verses.display_text:
Thou tookest pleasure in Thy land, Lord;
Thou didst turn back Jacob’s captivity.

verses.text: Thou forgavest Thy people their acts of lawlessness; Thou didst cover all their sins. Diapsalma.
Thou didst stop all Thy wrath; Thou didst turn away from the anger of Thy fury.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst stop all Thy wrath;
Thou didst turn away from the anger of Thy fury.

verses.text: Turn us back, God of our deliverances, and turn Thy fury away from us.
verses.display_text:
Turn us back, God of our deliverances,
and turn Thy fury away from us.

verses.text: Surely Thou wilt not be angry with us for ever, or extend Thy wrath from generation to generation?
verses.display_text:
Surely Thou wilt not be angry with us for ever,
or extend Thy wrath from generation to generation?

verses.text: God, Thou wilt turn back and give us life, and Thy people will rejoice in Thee.
verses.display_text:
God, Thou wilt turn back and give us life,
and Thy people will rejoice in Thee.

verses.text: Show us Thy mercy, Lord, and mayest Thou give us Thy salvation.
verses.display_text:
Show us Thy mercy, Lord,
and mayest Thou give us Thy salvation.

verses.text: I will hear what the Lord God will speak within me, for He will speak peace upon His people and upon His holy ones and upon those who turn their heart toward Him.
verses.display_text:
I will hear what the Lord God will speak within me,
for He will speak peace upon His people
and upon His holy ones
and upon those who turn their heart toward Him.

verses.text: Nevertheless His salvation is near those who fear Him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.display_text:
Nevertheless His salvation is near those who fear Him,
so that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.text: Mercy and truth met; righteousness and peace kissed.
verses.display_text:
Mercy and truth met;
righteousness and peace kissed.

verses.text: Truth sprang up from the earth, and righteousness looked down from heaven.
verses.display_text:
Truth sprang up from the earth,
and righteousness looked down from heaven.

verses.text: For the Lord will also give goodness, and our land will give its fruit.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord will also give goodness,
and our land will give its fruit.

verses.text: Righteousness will go ahead before Him and set His footsteps on a path.
verses.display_text:
Righteousness will go ahead before Him
and set His footsteps on a path.

verses.text: A prayer for David. Incline Thine ear, Lord, and hear me, for I am poor and needy.
verses.display_text:
A prayer for David.
Incline Thine ear, Lord, and hear me,
for I am poor and needy.

verses.text: Guard my soul, for I am holy; save Thy servant, my God, who hopes in Thee.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for unto Thee I will cry all day.
verses.display_text:
Have mercy on me, Lord,
for unto Thee I will cry all day.

verses.text: Gladden the soul of Thy servant, for unto Thee, Lord, I lifted my soul.
verses.display_text:
Gladden the soul of Thy servant,
for unto Thee, Lord, I lifted my soul.

verses.text: For Thou, Lord, art kind and forbearing, abundant in mercy to all who call on Thee.
verses.display_text:
For Thou, Lord, art kind and forbearing,
abundant in mercy to all who call on Thee.

verses.text: Give ear, Lord, to my prayer, and attend to the voice of my petition.
verses.display_text:
Give ear, Lord, to my prayer,
and attend to the voice of my petition.

verses.text: On the day of my affliction I cried unto Thee, for Thou heardest me.
verses.display_text:
On the day of my affliction I cried unto Thee,
for Thou heardest me.

verses.text: There is none like Thee among gods, Lord, and nothing is like Thy works.
verses.display_text:
There is none like Thee among gods, Lord,
and nothing is like Thy works.

verses.text: All the nations Thou madest will come and bow down before Thee, Lord, and glorify Thy name,
verses.display_text:
All the nations Thou madest will come
and bow down before Thee, Lord,
and glorify Thy name,

verses.text: for Thou art great and dost wondrous things; Thou alone art the great God.
verses.display_text:
for Thou art great and dost wondrous things;
Thou alone art the great God.

verses.text: Guide me in Thy way, Lord, and I will walk in Thy truth; let my heart rejoice to fear Thy name.
I will give Thee thanks, Lord my God, with all my heart, and glorify Thy name for ever,
verses.display_text:
I will give Thee thanks, Lord my God, with all my heart,
and glorify Thy name for ever,

verses.text: for Thy mercy toward me is great, and Thou didst deliver my soul from lowest Hades.
verses.display_text:
for Thy mercy toward me is great,
and Thou didst deliver my soul from lowest Hades.

verses.text: God, lawless people rose up against me, and an assembly of strong men sought my soul; they did not set Thee before them.
And Thou, Lord God, art compassionate and merciful, long-suffering, abundant in mercy, and true.
verses.display_text:
And Thou, Lord God, art compassionate and merciful,
long-suffering, abundant in mercy, and true.

verses.text: Look upon me and have mercy on me; give Thy might to Thy servant and save the son of Thy maidservant.
Work a sign for good with me, and let those who hate me see and be ashamed, for Thou, Lord, didst help and comfort me.
verses.display_text:
Work a sign for good with me,
and let those who hate me see and be ashamed,
for Thou, Lord, didst help and comfort me.

verses.text: For the sons of Korah, a psalm of a song. Its foundations are in the holy mountains.
verses.display_text:
For the sons of Korah, a psalm of a song.
Its foundations are in the holy mountains.

verses.text: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.display_text:
The Lord loves the gates of Zion
more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.text: Glorified things were spoken about you, city of God. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Glorified things were spoken about you, city of God.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: I will remember Raab and Babylon to those who know me. And look: foreigners and Tyre and the people of Ethiopians— these were born there.
verses.display_text:
I will remember Raab and Babylon to those who know me.
And look: foreigners and Tyre and the people of Ethiopians—
these were born there.

verses.text: “Mother Zion,” a man will say, and a man was born in her; and the Most High Himself founded her.
The Lord will recount in a register of peoples and of these rulers who were born in her. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will recount in a register of peoples
and of these rulers who were born in her.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: The dwelling in you is like that of all who rejoice.
verses.display_text: The dwelling in you is like that of all who rejoice.

verses.text: A song of a psalm for the sons of Korah. For the end; concerning Maeleth, for answering. Of understanding; of Heman the Israelite.
verses.display_text:
A song of a psalm for the sons of Korah.
For the end; concerning Maeleth, for answering.
Of understanding; of Heman the Israelite.

verses.text: Lord, God of my salvation, by day I cried out, and by night before Thee.
verses.display_text:
Lord, God of my salvation,
by day I cried out, and by night before Thee.

verses.text: Let my prayer enter before Thee; incline Thine ear to my petition, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Let my prayer enter before Thee;
incline Thine ear to my petition, Lord.

verses.text: For my soul was filled with evils, and my life drew near Hades.
verses.display_text:
For my soul was filled with evils,
and my life drew near Hades.

verses.text: I was counted with those descending into a pit; I became like a person without help, free among the dead,
like wounded people cast down, sleeping in a grave, whom Thou didst remember no more, and who were thrust away from Thy hand.
verses.display_text:
like wounded people cast down, sleeping in a grave,
whom Thou didst remember no more,
and who were thrust away from Thy hand.

verses.text: They put me in the lowest pit, in dark places and in death’s shadow.
verses.display_text:
They put me in the lowest pit,
in dark places and in death’s shadow.

verses.text: Thy fury rested firmly upon me, and Thou broughtest all Thy surges upon me. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Thy fury rested firmly upon me,
and Thou broughtest all Thy surges upon me.
Diapsalma.

verses.text: Thou didst remove my acquaintances far from me; they made me an abomination to themselves. I was handed over and did not go out.
My eyes grew weak from poverty. I cried unto Thee, Lord, all day; I spread my hands toward Thee:
Surely Thou wilt not work wonders for the dead? Or will physicians raise them, and will they give Thee thanks?
verses.display_text:
Surely Thou wilt not work wonders for the dead?
Or will physicians raise them, and will they give Thee thanks?

verses.text: Surely no one will recount Thy mercy in a grave and Thy truth in destruction?
verses.display_text:
Surely no one will recount Thy mercy in a grave
and Thy truth in destruction?

verses.text: Surely Thy wonders will not be known in darkness, or Thy righteousness in a forgotten land?
verses.display_text:
Surely Thy wonders will not be known in darkness,
or Thy righteousness in a forgotten land?

verses.text: And I cried unto Thee, Lord, and in the morning my prayer will reach Thee first.
verses.display_text:
And I cried unto Thee, Lord,
and in the morning my prayer will reach Thee first.

verses.text: Why, Lord, dost Thou thrust away my soul and turn Thy face away from me?
verses.display_text:
Why, Lord, dost Thou thrust away my soul
and turn Thy face away from me?

verses.text: I am poor and in toils from my youth; but after being raised up, I was humbled and left helpless.
verses.display_text:
I am poor and in toils from my youth;
but after being raised up, I was humbled and left helpless.

verses.text: Thy wraths passed over me, and Thy threats utterly troubled me;
verses.display_text:
Thy wraths passed over me,
and Thy threats utterly troubled me;

verses.text: they encircled me like water all day; together they closed around me.
verses.display_text:
they encircled me like water all day;
together they closed around me.

verses.text: Thou didst remove friend and neighbor far from me, and my acquaintances because of misery.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst remove friend and neighbor far from me,
and my acquaintances because of misery.

verses.text: Of understanding; of Ethan the Israelite.
verses.display_text: Of understanding; of Ethan the Israelite.

verses.text: I will sing of Thy mercies, Lord, for ever; from generation to generation I will proclaim Thy truth with my mouth,
verses.display_text:
I will sing of Thy mercies, Lord, for ever;
from generation to generation I will proclaim Thy truth with my mouth,

verses.text: for Thou saidst, “Mercy will be built for ever; in the heavens Thy truth will be prepared.”
verses.display_text:
for Thou saidst, “Mercy will be built for ever;
in the heavens Thy truth will be prepared.”

verses.text: “I made a covenant with My chosen ones; I swore to David My servant:
verses.display_text:
“I made a covenant with My chosen ones;
I swore to David My servant:

verses.text: ‘I will prepare your seed for ever and build your throne from generation to generation.’” Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
‘I will prepare your seed for ever
and build your throne from generation to generation.’”
Diapsalma.

verses.text: The heavens will acknowledge Thy wonders, Lord, and Thy truth in an assembly of holy ones.
verses.display_text:
The heavens will acknowledge Thy wonders, Lord,
and Thy truth in an assembly of holy ones.

verses.text: For who in clouds will be equaled to the Lord, and who among sons of God will be likened to the Lord?
verses.display_text:
For who in clouds will be equaled to the Lord,
and who among sons of God will be likened to the Lord?

verses.text: God is glorified in the council of holy ones, great and fearsome above all around Him.
verses.display_text:
God is glorified in the council of holy ones,
great and fearsome above all around Him.

verses.text: Lord, God of powers, who is like Thee? Thou art mighty, Lord, and Thy truth surrounds Thee.
verses.display_text:
Lord, God of powers, who is like Thee?
Thou art mighty, Lord, and Thy truth surrounds Thee.

verses.text: Thou rulest the sea’s might, and Thou quietest the surge of its waves.
verses.display_text:
Thou rulest the sea’s might,
and Thou quietest the surge of its waves.

verses.text: Thou didst humble a proud one like a wounded man, and with the arm of Thy power Thou didst scatter Thine enemies.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst humble a proud one like a wounded man,
and with the arm of Thy power Thou didst scatter Thine enemies.

verses.text: The heavens are Thine, and the earth is Thine; the inhabited world and its fullness—Thou didst found them.
verses.display_text:
The heavens are Thine, and the earth is Thine;
the inhabited world and its fullness—Thou didst found them.

verses.text: The north and seas—Thou didst create them; Tabor and Hermon will exult in Thy name.
verses.display_text:
The north and seas—Thou didst create them;
Tabor and Hermon will exult in Thy name.

verses.text: Thine is the arm with dominion; let Thy hand be strengthened; let Thy right hand be raised.
verses.display_text:
Thine is the arm with dominion;
let Thy hand be strengthened; let Thy right hand be raised.

verses.text: Righteousness and judgment are the preparation of Thy throne; mercy and truth will go ahead before Thy face.
verses.display_text:
Righteousness and judgment are the preparation of Thy throne;
mercy and truth will go ahead before Thy face.

verses.text: Blessed are the people who know the cry of triumph; Lord, they will walk in the light of Thy face,
verses.display_text:
Blessed are the people who know the cry of triumph;
Lord, they will walk in the light of Thy face,

verses.text: and in Thy name they will exult all day, and in Thy righteousness they will be raised up.
verses.display_text:
and in Thy name they will exult all day,
and in Thy righteousness they will be raised up.

verses.text: For Thou art the boast of their power, and by Thy favor our horn will be raised.
verses.display_text:
For Thou art the boast of their power,
and by Thy favor our horn will be raised.

verses.text: For support belongs to the Lord, and to the Holy One of Israel, our King.
verses.display_text:
For support belongs to the Lord,
and to the Holy One of Israel, our King.

verses.text: Then Thou spakest in a vision to Thy holy ones and saidst: “I placed help upon a powerful man; I raised a chosen one from My people.
I found David My servant; with My holy oil I anointed him,
verses.display_text:
I found David My servant;
with My holy oil I anointed him,

verses.text: for My hand will support him, and My arm will strengthen him.
verses.display_text:
for My hand will support him,
and My arm will strengthen him.

verses.text: An enemy will not gain by him, and a son of lawlessness will not go on to harm him.
verses.display_text:
An enemy will not gain by him,
and a son of lawlessness will not go on to harm him.

verses.text: I will cut down his enemies before him and put those who hate him to flight.
verses.display_text:
I will cut down his enemies before him
and put those who hate him to flight.

verses.text: My truth and My mercy will be with him, and in My name his horn will be raised.
verses.display_text:
My truth and My mercy will be with him,
and in My name his horn will be raised.

verses.text: I will set his hand in the sea and his right hand in rivers.
verses.display_text:
I will set his hand in the sea
and his right hand in rivers.

verses.text: He will call on Me, ‘Thou art my Father, my God and the supporter of my salvation.’
verses.display_text:
He will call on Me, ‘Thou art my Father,
my God and the supporter of my salvation.’

verses.text: And I will make him firstborn, high among the kings of the earth.
verses.display_text:
And I will make him firstborn,
high among the kings of the earth.

verses.text: For ever I will keep My mercy for him, and My covenant is faithful to him.
verses.display_text:
For ever I will keep My mercy for him,
and My covenant is faithful to him.

verses.text: I will establish his seed for an age of an age and his throne like the days of heaven.
verses.display_text:
I will establish his seed for an age of an age
and his throne like the days of heaven.

verses.text: If his sons abandon My law and do not walk in My judgments,
verses.display_text:
If his sons abandon My law
and do not walk in My judgments,

verses.text: if they profane My ordinances and do not keep My commandments,
verses.display_text:
if they profane My ordinances
and do not keep My commandments,

verses.text: I will visit their lawless acts with a rod and their sins with scourges;
verses.display_text:
I will visit their lawless acts with a rod
and their sins with scourges;

verses.text: but I shall certainly not scatter My mercy away from him, nor act unjustly in My truth,
verses.display_text:
but I shall certainly not scatter My mercy away from him,
nor act unjustly in My truth,

verses.text: nor shall I profane My covenant, and what goes out through My lips I shall certainly not set aside.
verses.display_text:
nor shall I profane My covenant,
and what goes out through My lips I shall certainly not set aside.

verses.text: Once I swore by My holiness: I will not lie to David.
verses.display_text:
Once I swore by My holiness:
I will not lie to David.

verses.text: His seed will remain for ever, and his throne will be like the sun before Me,
verses.display_text:
His seed will remain for ever,
and his throne will be like the sun before Me,

verses.text: and like the moon, established for ever; and the witness in heaven is faithful.” Diapsalma.
But Thou didst reject and treat as nothing; Thou didst put off Thine anointed.
verses.display_text:
But Thou didst reject and treat as nothing;
Thou didst put off Thine anointed.

verses.text: Thou didst overturn Thy servant’s covenant; Thou didst profane his consecrated thing to the ground.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst overturn Thy servant’s covenant;
Thou didst profane his consecrated thing to the ground.

verses.text: Thou didst tear down all his fences; Thou madest his fortifications cowardice.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst tear down all his fences;
Thou madest his fortifications cowardice.

verses.text: All who travel the road plundered him; he became a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.display_text:
All who travel the road plundered him;
he became a reproach to his neighbors.

verses.text: Thou didst raise the right hand of his enemies; Thou didst gladden all his enemies.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst raise the right hand of his enemies;
Thou didst gladden all his enemies.

verses.text: Thou didst turn back the help of his sword and didst not support him in war.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst turn back the help of his sword
and didst not support him in war.

verses.text: Thou didst remove him from purification; Thou didst dash his throne down to the ground.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst remove him from purification;
Thou didst dash his throne down to the ground.

verses.text: Thou didst shorten the days of his time; Thou didst pour shame over him. Diapsalma.
How long, Lord? Wilt Thou turn away to the end? Will Thy wrath blaze like fire?
verses.display_text:
How long, Lord? Wilt Thou turn away to the end?
Will Thy wrath blaze like fire?

verses.text: Remember what my existence is; for surely Thou didst not create all the sons of men in vain?
verses.display_text:
Remember what my existence is;
for surely Thou didst not create all the sons of men in vain?

verses.text: Who is the person who will live and not see death, who will deliver his soul from the hand of Hades? Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Who is the person who will live and not see death,
who will deliver his soul from the hand of Hades?
Diapsalma.

verses.text: Where are Thine ancient mercies, Lord, which Thou didst swear to David in Thy truth?
verses.display_text:
Where are Thine ancient mercies, Lord,
which Thou didst swear to David in Thy truth?

verses.text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of Thy servants, which I bore in my bosom from many nations,
verses.display_text:
Remember, Lord, the reproach of Thy servants,
which I bore in my bosom from many nations,

verses.text: with which Thine enemies reproached, Lord, with which they reproached the exchange of Thine anointed.
verses.display_text:
with which Thine enemies reproached, Lord,
with which they reproached the exchange of Thine anointed.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord for ever. May it be; may it be.
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord for ever.
May it be; may it be.

verses.text: A prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, Thou becamest our refuge through every generation.
verses.display_text:
A prayer of Moses, the man of God.
Lord, Thou becamest our refuge through every generation.

verses.text: Before the mountains came to be and the earth and inhabited world were formed, from age to age Thou art.
verses.display_text:
Before the mountains came to be
and the earth and inhabited world were formed,
from age to age Thou art.

verses.text: Do not turn a man toward humiliation; and Thou saidst, Return, sons of men.
verses.display_text:
Do not turn a man toward humiliation;
and Thou saidst, Return, sons of men.

verses.text: For a thousand years in Thine eyes are like yesterday, which passed, and a watch in the night.
verses.display_text:
For a thousand years in Thine eyes
are like yesterday, which passed,
and a watch in the night.

verses.text: Their things counted as nothing will be years. In the morning, like green grass, may it pass away;
verses.display_text:
Their things counted as nothing will be years.
In the morning, like green grass, may it pass away;

verses.text: in the morning may it blossom and pass away; in the evening may it fall, grow hard and dry up.
verses.display_text:
in the morning may it blossom and pass away;
in the evening may it fall, grow hard and dry up.

verses.text: For we failed in Thine anger and were troubled in Thy wrath.
verses.display_text:
For we failed in Thine anger
and were troubled in Thy wrath.

verses.text: Thou didst set our lawless deeds before Thee; our age is in the light of Thy face.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst set our lawless deeds before Thee;
our age is in the light of Thy face.

verses.text: For all our days failed, and in Thine anger we failed; I pondered our years like a spider.
The days of our years—in them are seventy years, or, with strength, eighty years; the greater part of them is toil and pain, for gentleness came upon us, and we shall be disciplined.
verses.display_text:
The days of our years—in them are seventy years,
or, with strength, eighty years;
the greater part of them is toil and pain,
for gentleness came upon us, and we shall be disciplined.

verses.text: Who knows the might of Thine anger, and Thy wrath from the fear of Thee?
verses.display_text:
Who knows the might of Thine anger,
and Thy wrath from the fear of Thee?

verses.text: So make known how to number Thy right hand, and those bound in heart in wisdom.
verses.display_text:
So make known how to number Thy right hand,
and those bound in heart in wisdom.

verses.text: Return, Lord—how long? Be moved concerning Thy servants.
verses.display_text:
Return, Lord—how long?
Be moved concerning Thy servants.

verses.text: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, and we exulted and rejoiced all our days.
verses.display_text:
We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy,
and we exulted and rejoiced all our days.

verses.text: We were glad in return for the days Thou didst humble us, the years when we saw evils.
verses.display_text:
We were glad in return for the days Thou didst humble us,
the years when we saw evils.

verses.text: Look upon Thy servants and Thy works, and guide their children.
verses.display_text:
Look upon Thy servants and Thy works,
and guide their children.

verses.text: Let the splendor of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct the works of our hands for us.
verses.display_text:
Let the splendor of the Lord our God be upon us,
and direct the works of our hands for us.

verses.text: A praise of a song, of David. The one dwelling in the help of the Most High will lodge in the shelter of the God of heaven.
verses.display_text:
A praise of a song, of David.
The one dwelling in the help of the Most High
will lodge in the shelter of the God of heaven.

verses.text: He will say to the Lord, Thou art my Helper and my refuge, my God; I will hope in Him.
verses.display_text:
He will say to the Lord, Thou art my Helper and my refuge,
my God; I will hope in Him.

verses.text: For He will rescue me from the hunters’ trap and from a disturbing word.
verses.display_text:
For He will rescue me from the hunters’ trap
and from a disturbing word.

verses.text: With His shoulders He will overshadow you, and under His wings you will hope; His truth will surround you with a weapon.
You will not fear terror by night, the missile flying by day,
verses.display_text:
You will not fear terror by night,
the missile flying by day,

verses.text: the thing passing through darkness, the calamity and the demon of noon.
verses.display_text:
the thing passing through darkness,
the calamity and the demon of noon.

verses.text: A thousand will fall at your side and ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
verses.display_text:
A thousand will fall at your side
and ten thousand at your right hand,
but it will not come near you.

verses.text: You will only observe with your eyes and see the repayment of sinners.
verses.display_text:
You will only observe with your eyes
and see the repayment of sinners.

verses.text: For Thou, Lord, art my hope. You have made the Most High your refuge.
verses.display_text:
