I am alone until I pass by.

verses.text: Of understanding, of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
verses.display_text: Of understanding, of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.

verses.text: With my voice I cried to the Lord; with my voice I pleaded with the Lord.
verses.display_text:
With my voice I cried to the Lord;
with my voice I pleaded with the Lord.

verses.text: I will pour out my plea before Him; I will declare my affliction before Him.
verses.display_text:
I will pour out my plea before Him;
I will declare my affliction before Him.

verses.text: When my spirit was failing within me, Thou knewest my paths. On this way where I was walking, they hid a trap for me.
verses.display_text:
When my spirit was failing within me,
Thou knewest my paths.
On this way where I was walking, they hid a trap for me.

verses.text: I looked to the right and observed, for there was no one recognizing me. Escape perished from me, and there is no one seeking my soul.
verses.display_text:
I looked to the right and observed, for there was no one recognizing me.
Escape perished from me,
and there is no one seeking my soul.

verses.text: I cried unto Thee, Lord; I said, Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.
Attend to my plea, for I was brought very low. Rescue me from those pursuing me, for they grew stronger than I.
verses.display_text:
Attend to my plea, for I was brought very low.
Rescue me from those pursuing me,
for they grew stronger than I.

verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may thank Thy name, Lord. The righteous will wait for me until Thou repayest me.
verses.display_text:
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may thank Thy name, Lord.
The righteous will wait for me
until Thou repayest me.

verses.text: A psalm of David, when his son pursues him. Lord, hear my prayer; give ear to my plea in Thy truth. Answer me in Thy righteousness.
verses.display_text:
A psalm of David, when his son pursues him.
Lord, hear my prayer; give ear to my plea in Thy truth.
Answer me in Thy righteousness.

verses.text: Do not enter into judgment with Thy servant, for no one living will be justified before Thee.
verses.display_text:
Do not enter into judgment with Thy servant,
for no one living will be justified before Thee.

verses.text: For the enemy pursued my soul, brought my life low to the ground, made me sit in dark places like those long dead.
verses.display_text:
For the enemy pursued my soul,
brought my life low to the ground,
made me sit in dark places like those long dead.

verses.text: My spirit grew despondent within me; within me my heart was troubled.
verses.display_text:
My spirit grew despondent within me;
within me my heart was troubled.

verses.text: I remembered ancient days and meditated on all Thy works; I was pondering the works of Thy hands.
I spread out my hands unto Thee; my soul is like a waterless land for Thee. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
I spread out my hands unto Thee;
my soul is like a waterless land for Thee. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Quickly hear me, Lord; my spirit is spent. Do not turn Thy face away from me, or I shall become like those descending to the pit.
verses.display_text:
Quickly hear me, Lord; my spirit is spent.
Do not turn Thy face away from me,
or I shall become like those descending to the pit.

verses.text: Make Thy mercy heard by me in the morning, for I hoped in Thee. Make known to me, Lord, the way I shall walk, for unto Thee I lifted my soul.
verses.display_text:
Make Thy mercy heard by me in the morning, for I hoped in Thee.
Make known to me, Lord, the way I shall walk,
for unto Thee I lifted my soul.

verses.text: Take me out from my enemies, Lord, for I fled unto Thee for refuge.
verses.display_text:
Take me out from my enemies, Lord,
for I fled unto Thee for refuge.

verses.text: Teach me to do Thy will, for Thou art my God. Thy good Spirit will lead me on level ground.
verses.display_text:
Teach me to do Thy will, for Thou art my God.
Thy good Spirit will lead me on level ground.

verses.text: For Thy name’s sake, Lord, Thou wilt give me life; in Thy righteousness Thou wilt bring my soul out of distress.
verses.display_text:
For Thy name’s sake, Lord, Thou wilt give me life;
in Thy righteousness Thou wilt bring my soul out of distress.

verses.text: In Thy mercy Thou wilt utterly destroy my enemies and destroy all who distress my soul, for I am Thy servant.
verses.display_text:
In Thy mercy Thou wilt utterly destroy my enemies
and destroy all who distress my soul,
for I am Thy servant.

verses.text: Of David, concerning Goliath. Blessed is the Lord, my God, who trains my hands for battle array, my fingers for war.
verses.display_text:
Of David, concerning Goliath.
Blessed is the Lord, my God,
who trains my hands for battle array, my fingers for war.

verses.text: My mercy and my refuge, my Helper and my Rescuer, my Defender, in whom I hoped, who subjects my people beneath me.
verses.display_text:
My mercy and my refuge, my Helper and my Rescuer,
my Defender, in whom I hoped,
who subjects my people beneath me.

verses.text: Lord, what is man, that Thou becamest known to him, or a son of man, that Thou takest account of him?
verses.display_text:
Lord, what is man, that Thou becamest known to him,
or a son of man, that Thou takest account of him?

verses.text: A man was likened to futility; his days pass like a shadow.
verses.display_text:
A man was likened to futility;
his days pass like a shadow.

verses.text: Lord, bend Thy heavens and descend; touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
verses.display_text:
Lord, bend Thy heavens and descend;
touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

verses.text: Flash lightning, and Thou wilt scatter them; send out Thine arrows, and Thou wilt throw them into confusion.
verses.display_text:
Flash lightning, and Thou wilt scatter them;
send out Thine arrows, and Thou wilt throw them into confusion.

verses.text: Send out Thy hand from on high; take me out and rescue me from many waters, from the hand of foreigners.
Whose mouth spoke futility, and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.
verses.display_text:
Whose mouth spoke futility,
and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.

verses.text: God, I will sing a new song unto Thee; on a ten-stringed psaltery I will make music unto Thee.
verses.display_text:
God, I will sing a new song unto Thee;
on a ten-stringed psaltery I will make music unto Thee.

verses.text: To Him who gives salvation to kings, who redeems David His servant from an evil sword.
verses.display_text:
To Him who gives salvation to kings,
who redeems David His servant from an evil sword.

verses.text: Rescue me and take me out from the hand of foreigners, whose mouth spoke futility and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.
verses.display_text:
Rescue me and take me out from the hand of foreigners,
whose mouth spoke futility
and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.

verses.text: Whose sons are like young plants established in their youth, their daughters beautified, adorned all around like the likeness of a sanctuary.
verses.display_text:
Whose sons are like young plants established in their youth,
their daughters beautified,
adorned all around like the likeness of a sanctuary.

verses.text: Their storehouses full, pouring forth from this to that; their sheep bearing many young, multiplying in their outgoing places.
Their oxen fat; there is no collapse of a fence and no passage out, nor any cry in their squares.
They called happy the people who have these things; happy the people whose God is the Lord.
verses.display_text:
They called happy the people who have these things;
happy the people whose God is the Lord.

verses.text: A praise of David. I will exalt Thee, my God, my King, and bless Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
A praise of David.
I will exalt Thee, my God, my King,
and bless Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.

verses.text: Every day I will bless Thee and praise Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
Every day I will bless Thee
and praise Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.

verses.text: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised; His greatness has no limit.
verses.display_text:
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised;
His greatness has no limit.

verses.text: Generation after generation will praise Thy works, and they will declare Thy power.
verses.display_text:
Generation after generation will praise Thy works,
and they will declare Thy power.

verses.text: They will speak of the magnificence of the glory of Thy holiness, and they will recount Thy wonders.
verses.display_text:
They will speak of the magnificence of the glory of Thy holiness,
and they will recount Thy wonders.

verses.text: They will speak of the power of Thy fearsome acts, and they will recount Thy greatness.
verses.display_text:
They will speak of the power of Thy fearsome acts,
and they will recount Thy greatness.

verses.text: They will pour forth remembrance of the abundance of Thy kindness and rejoice in Thy righteousness.
verses.display_text:
They will pour forth remembrance of the abundance of Thy kindness
and rejoice in Thy righteousness.

verses.text: Compassionate and merciful is the Lord, patient and abundant in mercy.
verses.display_text:
Compassionate and merciful is the Lord,
patient and abundant in mercy.

verses.text: The Lord is kind to all, and His compassions are over all His works.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is kind to all,
and His compassions are over all His works.

verses.text: Let all Thy works give thanks unto Thee, Lord, and let Thy holy ones bless Thee.
verses.display_text:
Let all Thy works give thanks unto Thee, Lord,
and let Thy holy ones bless Thee.

verses.text: They will speak of the glory of Thy kingdom and tell of Thy might,
verses.display_text:
They will speak of the glory of Thy kingdom
and tell of Thy might,

verses.text: to make known to the sons of men Thy might and the glory of the magnificence of Thy kingdom.
verses.display_text:
to make known to the sons of men Thy might
and the glory of the magnificence of Thy kingdom.

verses.text: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and Thy lordship endures through every generation.
verses.display_text:
Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages,
and Thy lordship endures through every generation.

verses.text: Faithful is the Lord in His words, and holy in all His works.
verses.display_text:
Faithful is the Lord in His words,
and holy in all His works.

verses.text: The Lord supports all who are falling and raises up all who have been broken down.
verses.display_text:
The Lord supports all who are falling
and raises up all who have been broken down.

verses.text: The eyes of all hope in Thee, and Thou givest their food at the right time.
verses.display_text:
The eyes of all hope in Thee,
and Thou givest their food at the right time.

verses.text: Thou openest Thy hand and fillest every living creature with good pleasure.
verses.display_text:
Thou openest Thy hand
and fillest every living creature with good pleasure.

verses.text: The Lord is righteous in all His ways and holy in all His works.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is righteous in all His ways
and holy in all His works.

verses.text: The Lord is near to all who call on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is near to all who call on Him,
to all who call on Him in truth.

verses.text: He will fulfill the will of those who fear Him; He will hear their plea and save them.
verses.display_text:
He will fulfill the will of those who fear Him;
He will hear their plea and save them.

verses.text: The Lord guards all who love Him, and all sinners He will utterly destroy.
verses.display_text:
The Lord guards all who love Him,
and all sinners He will utterly destroy.

verses.text: My mouth will speak the Lord’s praise, and let all flesh bless His holy name for the age and for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
My mouth will speak the Lord’s praise,
and let all flesh bless His holy name
for the age and for the age of the age.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, my soul.
verses.display_text:
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah.
Praise the Lord, my soul.

verses.text: I will praise the Lord throughout my life; I will make music to my God as long as I exist.
verses.display_text:
I will praise the Lord throughout my life;
I will make music to my God as long as I exist.

verses.text: Do not trust in rulers and in sons of men who have no salvation.
verses.display_text:
Do not trust in rulers
and in sons of men who have no salvation.

verses.text: His spirit will go out, and he will return to his earth; on that day all their reasonings will perish.
verses.display_text:
His spirit will go out, and he will return to his earth;
on that day all their reasonings will perish.

verses.text: Happy the one whose Helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God,
verses.display_text:
Happy the one whose Helper is the God of Jacob,
whose hope is in the Lord his God,

verses.text: who made heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them, who keeps truth for ever,
verses.display_text:
who made heaven and earth,
the sea and all that is in them,
who keeps truth for ever,

verses.text: who does justice for those wronged, who gives food to the hungry. The Lord releases those in fetters.
verses.display_text:
who does justice for those wronged,
who gives food to the hungry.
The Lord releases those in fetters.

verses.text: The Lord raises up those broken down; the Lord makes the blind wise; the Lord loves the righteous.
The Lord guards the newcomers; He will take up the orphan and widow, and He will obliterate the way of sinners.
The Lord will reign for ever, your God, Zion, through every generation.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will reign for ever,
your God, Zion, through every generation.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, for a psalm is good; may praise be pleasing to our God.
The Lord builds Jerusalem, and He will gather the dispersed of Israel.
verses.display_text:
The Lord builds Jerusalem,
and He will gather the dispersed of Israel.

verses.text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their fractures.
verses.display_text:
He heals the brokenhearted
and binds up their fractures.

verses.text: He numbers multitudes of stars and calls them all by names.
verses.display_text:
He numbers multitudes of stars
and calls them all by names.

verses.text: Great is our Lord, and great is His strength; His understanding is beyond number.
verses.display_text:
Great is our Lord, and great is His strength;
His understanding is beyond number.

verses.text: The Lord takes up the meek, but brings sinners low to the ground.
verses.display_text:
The Lord takes up the meek,
but brings sinners low to the ground.

verses.text: Begin singing to the Lord with thanksgiving; make music to our God with a lyre,
verses.display_text:
Begin singing to the Lord with thanksgiving;
make music to our God with a lyre,

verses.text: who clothes heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass sprout on the mountains and green growth for the service of humans,
verses.display_text:
who clothes heaven with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass sprout on the mountains
and green growth for the service of humans,

verses.text: who gives the cattle their food and to the young ravens who call upon Him.
verses.display_text:
who gives the cattle their food
and to the young ravens who call upon Him.

verses.text: He will not delight in the horse’s might, nor does He take pleasure in a man’s shins.
verses.display_text:
He will not delight in the horse’s might,
nor does He take pleasure in a man’s shins.

verses.text: The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him and in those who hope in His mercy.
verses.display_text:
The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him
and in those who hope in His mercy.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Commend the Lord, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.
For He strengthened the bars of your gates; He blessed your children within you.
verses.display_text:
For He strengthened the bars of your gates;
He blessed your children within you.

verses.text: He makes your borders peaceful and fills you with the finest wheat.
verses.display_text:
He makes your borders peaceful
and fills you with the finest wheat.

verses.text: He sends His oracle to the earth; His word will run swiftly,
verses.display_text:
He sends His oracle to the earth;
His word will run swiftly,

verses.text: of Him who gives snow like wool, who sprinkles mist like ashes,
verses.display_text:
of Him who gives snow like wool,
who sprinkles mist like ashes,

verses.text: who casts His ice like morsels; who will withstand His cold?
verses.display_text:
who casts His ice like morsels;
who will withstand His cold?

verses.text: He will send His word and melt them; He will blow His wind, and waters will flow.
verses.display_text:
He will send His word and melt them;
He will blow His wind, and waters will flow.

verses.text: He declares His word to Jacob, His ordinances and judgments to Israel.
verses.display_text:
He declares His word to Jacob,
His ordinances and judgments to Israel.

verses.text: He did not do so for any nation, and He did not disclose His judgments to them.
verses.display_text:
He did not do so for any nation,
and He did not disclose His judgments to them.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His powers.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him, all His angels;
praise Him, all His powers.

verses.text: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all the stars and the light.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him, sun and moon;
praise Him, all the stars and the light.

verses.text: Praise Him, heavens of heavens, and the water above the heavens.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him, heavens of heavens,
and the water above the heavens.

verses.text: Let them praise the Lord’s name, for He spoke, and they came to be; He commanded, and they were created.
He established them for the age and for the age of the age; He set a command, and it will not pass away.
verses.display_text:
He established them for the age and for the age of the age;
He set a command, and it will not pass away.

verses.text: Praise the Lord from the earth, dragons and all deeps,
verses.display_text:
Praise the Lord from the earth,
dragons and all deeps,

verses.text: fire, hail, snow, ice, storm wind—all fulfilling His word,
verses.display_text:
fire, hail, snow, ice,
storm wind—all fulfilling His word,

verses.text: mountains and all hills, fruit-bearing trees and all cedars,
verses.display_text:
mountains and all hills,
fruit-bearing trees and all cedars,

verses.text: wild animals and all cattle, creeping things and winged birds,
verses.display_text:
wild animals and all cattle,
creeping things and winged birds,

verses.text: kings of the earth and all peoples, rulers and all judges of the earth,
verses.display_text:
kings of the earth and all peoples,
rulers and all judges of the earth,

verses.text: young men and young women, old people with younger people.
verses.display_text:
young men and young women,
old people with younger people.

verses.text: Let them praise the Lord’s name, for His name alone was exalted; His praise is over earth and heaven.
verses.display_text:
Let them praise the Lord’s name, for His name alone was exalted;
His praise is over earth and heaven.

verses.text: He will raise a horn of His people— a hymn for all His holy ones, for the children of Israel, a people drawing near to Him.
verses.display_text:
He will raise a horn of His people—
a hymn for all His holy ones,
for the children of Israel, a people drawing near to Him.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Sing a new song to the Lord, His praise in the assembly of holy ones.
verses.display_text:
Hallelujah.
Sing a new song to the Lord,
His praise in the assembly of holy ones.

verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in the One who made it, and let Zion’s children exult in their King.
verses.display_text:
Let Israel rejoice in the One who made it,
and let Zion’s children exult in their King.

verses.text: Let them praise His name in a chorus; with tambourine and psaltery let them make music to Him.
verses.display_text:
Let them praise His name in a chorus;
with tambourine and psaltery let them make music to Him.

verses.text: For the Lord takes pleasure in His people, and He will exalt the meek in salvation.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord takes pleasure in His people,
and He will exalt the meek in salvation.

verses.text: Holy ones will boast in glory and rejoice upon their beds.
verses.display_text:
Holy ones will boast in glory
and rejoice upon their beds.

verses.text: Exaltations of God in their throat, and two-edged swords in their hands,
verses.display_text:
Exaltations of God in their throat,
and two-edged swords in their hands,

verses.text: to execute vengeance among the nations, reproofs among the peoples,
verses.display_text:
to execute vengeance among the nations,
reproofs among the peoples,

verses.text: to bind their kings in fetters and their glorious ones in iron handcuffs,
verses.display_text:
to bind their kings in fetters
and their glorious ones in iron handcuffs,

verses.text: to execute upon them a written judgment. This is glory for all His holy ones.
verses.display_text:
to execute upon them a written judgment.
This is glory for all His holy ones.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Praise God among His holy ones; praise Him in the firmament of His power.
Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him for His mighty acts;
praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.

verses.text: Praise Him with the sound of a trumpet; praise Him with psaltery and lyre.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him with the sound of a trumpet;
praise Him with psaltery and lyre.

verses.text: Praise Him with tambourine and chorus; praise Him with strings and instrument.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him with tambourine and chorus;
praise Him with strings and instrument.

verses.text: Praise Him with well-sounding cymbals; praise Him with cymbals of a shout.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him with well-sounding cymbals;
praise Him with cymbals of a shout.

verses.text: Let every breath praise the Lord. Hallelujah.
verses.display_text:
Let every breath praise the Lord.
Hallelujah.

verses.text: This psalm is personally written concerning David and is outside the number, when he fought Goliath in single combat. I was small among my brothers and younger in my father’s house; I was shepherding my father’s sheep.
verses.display_text:
This psalm is personally written concerning David and is outside the number, when he fought Goliath in single combat.
I was small among my brothers
and younger in my father’s house;
I was shepherding my father’s sheep.

verses.text: My hands made an instrument; my fingers fitted a psaltery.
verses.display_text:
My hands made an instrument;
my fingers fitted a psaltery.

verses.text: And who shall tell my Lord? He Himself is Lord; He Himself hears.
verses.display_text:
And who shall tell my Lord?
He Himself is Lord; He Himself hears.

verses.text: He Himself sent out His angel and took me from my father’s sheep and anointed me with the oil of His anointing.
verses.display_text:
He Himself sent out His angel
and took me from my father’s sheep
and anointed me with the oil of His anointing.

verses.text: My brothers were handsome and tall, but the Lord took no pleasure in them.
verses.display_text:
My brothers were handsome and tall,
but the Lord took no pleasure in them.

verses.text: I went out to meet the foreigner, and he cursed me by his idols.
verses.display_text:
I went out to meet the foreigner,
and he cursed me by his idols.

verses.text: But I drew the sword he carried, cut off his head, and removed reproach from the sons of Israel.
verses.display_text:
But I drew the sword he carried,
cut off his head,
and removed reproach from the sons of Israel.
